overview: 今日共收录72篇文献，覆盖机器学习、计算物理和功能材料方向。
trends: 文献主要涉及结构—性质建模、有限温度/动力学模拟以及材料电子与磁性问题；缺少原文细节的条目不作定量推断。

full_list.title_en: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
full_list.title_zh: 可扩展的远程机器学习原子间势与原子材料建模的电响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate atomistic simulations of materials under electric fields require long-range electrostatics and electrical-response modeling at length scales beyond the reach of conventional first-principles methods. Yet these capabilities remain difficult to reconcile with the scalability of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Strictly local models enable efficient spatial parallelization but neglect long-range interactions, whereas existing electrostatic extensions introduce global dependencies that hinder distributed computation. Here, we overcome this limitation by analytically separating the long-range electrostatic forces and Born effective charges (BECs) into a global electrostatics calculation and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges. This formulation preserves the spatial decomposability of equivariant MLIPs while enabling distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and BECs across different boundary conditions. Implemented as DPA4C-LR on the textttnvalchemi platform, the framework scales to 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the computational cost of its short-range backbone. Trained on energies and forces, DPA4C-LR accurately infers BECs and reproduces the field-dependent infrared spectra of water. We further demonstrate its capabilities by recovering the characteristic slim polarization hysteresis of relaxor cePb(Mg₁/₃Nb₂/₃)O3, which is obscured by finite-size effects in smaller simulations; predicting a room-temperature field-driven ionic conductivity of 6.8 ± 0.7~mS/cm in amorphous ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁; and modeling interfacial thermal transport across Si/diamond interfaces with slab-corrected electrostatics. By combining long-range physics, electrical-response inference, and distributed computation, this framework extends predictive atomistic modeling toward device-relevant length scales.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。该公式保留了等变 MLIP 的空间可分解性，同时能够跨不同边界条件对能量、力、应力和 BEC 进行分布式评估。该框架在 textttnvalchemi 平台上以 DPA4C-LR 的形式实现，可在四个 GPU 上扩展到 520 万个原子，计算成本约为其短程主干的两倍。经过能量和力的训练，DPA4C-LR 可以准确推断 BEC 并再现水的场相关红外光谱。我们通过恢复弛豫剂 cePb(Mg₁/₃Nb2/₃)O3 特有的微小偏振迟滞来进一步证明其能力，该迟滞在较小的模拟中被有限尺寸效应所掩盖；预测非晶 ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl4.₁ 中的室温场驱动离子电导率为 6.8 ± 0.7~mS/cm；并利用平板校正静电对跨硅/金刚石界面的界面热传输进行建模。通过结合远程物理、电响应推理和分布式计算，该框架将预测原子建模扩展到与设备相关的长度尺度。
full_list.summary: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《可扩展的远程机器学习原子间势与原子材料建模的电响应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Training Dataset Matters for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Water Simulation as an Example
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Training Dataset Matters for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Water Simulation as an Example
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.23939v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate predictions of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) rely on training datasets covering relevant thermodynamic conditions and phases. Using water as an example, we show that insufficiently sampled datasets of MLIPs lead to wrong predictions of densities, melting temperatures, and nuclear quantum effects. In contrast, MLIPs trained on comprehensive datasets with the same electronic structure method yield consistent property predictions agnostic of MLIP architecture, with densities in quantitative agreement with reference calculations.

full_list.title_en: Linear response for machine-learned interatomic potentials: phonons at arbitrary wave vectors from the primitive cell
full_list.title_zh: 机器学习原子间势的线性响应：来自原始细胞的任意波矢量的声子
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon calculations with machine-learned interatomic potentials are almost exclusively performed with finite displacements in supercells, an approach that is exact only at wave vectors commensurate with the supercell and whose error depends on the range of the force constants. In message-passing networks this range grows with the number of layers, and reaches 140 angstrom for the deepest universal models. Here we show that the dynamical matrix of a message-passing potential can be obtained exactly in the primitive cell, at any wave vector, as the linear response of the forces to a displacement modulated by a Bloch phase, in the spirit of density-functional perturbation theory. The phase enters only where the features of neighboring atoms are gathered, and the trained model is used without modification. One further derivative yields group velocities and mode Grüneisen parameters analytically. We apply the method to NequIP and Prophet, and reproduce the Hessians of supercells to machine precision. Using these results as a reference, we find that the supercells commonly employed in high-throughput calculations lead to errors of several tenths of a THz in the phonon frequencies, and that these errors decrease slowly with the size of the supercell, in particular for deep models. For a low-symmetry silicate, the supercell predicts a dynamical instability that the model does not have. Quantities that depend on derivatives of the dispersion, such as the group velocities and the Grüneisen parameter at low temperature, are considerably more affected than the frequencies themselves. When both approaches are used to obtain the same force constants, their computational cost is comparable for crystals with symmetry.
full_list.abstract_zh: 使用机器学习的原子间势的声子计算几乎完全是在超级单元中的有限位移下进行的，这种方法仅在与超级单元相称的波矢量上才准确，其误差取决于力常数的范围。在消息传递网络中，这个范围随着层数的增加而增长，对于最深的通用模型来说达到 140 埃。在这里，我们证明，本着密度泛函微扰理论的精神，可以在任何波矢量下在原胞中精确地获得消息传递势的动态矩阵，作为力对布洛赫相位调制的位移的线性响应。仅当相邻原子的特征聚集时才进入该阶段，并且训练后的模型无需修改即可使用。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 使用机器学习的原子间势的声子计算几乎完全是在超级单元中的有限位移下进行的，这种方法仅在与超级单元相称的波矢量上才准确，其误差取决于力常数的范围。在消息传递网络中，这个范围随着层数的增加而增长，对于最深的通用模型来说达到 140 埃。在这里，我们证明，本着密度泛函微扰理论的精神，可以在任何波矢量下在原胞中精确地获得消息传递势的动态矩阵，作为力对布洛赫相位调制的位移的线性响应。仅当相邻原子的特征聚集时才进入该阶段，并且训练后的模型无需修改即可使用。另一种导数可通过分析得出群速度和模式 Grüneisen 参数。我们将该方法应用于 NequIP 和 Prophet，并重现了超级单元的 Hessian 矩阵以达到机器精度。以这些结果为参考，我们发现高通量计算中常用的超级单元会导致声子频率达到十分之几太赫兹的误差，并且这些误差随着超级单元的尺寸缓慢减小，特别是对于深度模型。对于低对称性硅酸盐，超晶胞预测了模型所不具备的动力学不稳定性。取决于色散导数的量（例如低温下的群速度和 Grüneisen 参数）比频率本身受到的影响要大得多。当使用两种方法获得相同的力常数时，对于对称晶体，它们的计算成本是相当的。

full_list.title_en: From Surface Reactions to Inhibitor Coverage: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Computational Study of Area-Selective Atomic Layer Deposition
full_list.title_zh: 从表面反应到抑制剂覆盖：区域选择性原子层沉积的机器学习辅助计算研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Area-selective atomic layer deposition (AS-ALD) enables selective material growth for the fabrication of nanoscale semiconductor devices. Predicting inhibitor coverage is essential for understanding and optimizing surface blocking in AS-ALD. Here, we present a computational workflow combining a pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potential with off-lattice grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations and apply it to inhibitor adsorption and precursor blocking on amorphous SiO2. Realistic surface models reveal substantial site-dependent variations in reaction energies and activation barriers, with silanol groups serving as the primary adsorption sites for aminosilane and related inhibitors and metal precursors. Coverage simulations show that inhibitors producing identical adsorbed fragments can yield different coverages because the intact molecules impose distinct steric constraints, leading to different accessible site densities and blocking capabilities. Beyond coverage, we highlight the importance of the reactivity of adsorbed inhibitor fragments toward precursors in determining inhibitor stability and blocking performance. Together, these findings demonstrate the need to consider both steric effects and chemical reactivity on realistic amorphous surfaces. Our calculations connect local reaction chemistry with inhibitor coverage and provide a computational basis for understanding inhibition mechanisms and selecting suitable inhibitor-precursor combinations for AS-ALD.
full_list.abstract_zh: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。覆盖模拟表明，产生相同吸附片段的抑制剂可以产生不同的覆盖范围，因为完整的分子施加不同的空间限制，导致不同的可接近位点密度和阻断能力。除了覆盖范围之外，我们还强调了吸附的抑制剂片段对前体的反应性在确定抑制剂稳定性和阻断性能方面的重要性。总之，这些发现表明需要考虑现实非晶表面上的空间效应和化学反应性。我们的计算将局部反应化学与抑制剂覆盖率联系起来，并为理解抑制机制和为 AS-ALD 选择合适的抑制剂-前体组合提供计算基础。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：蒙特卡洛统计采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Physics-Informed Machine Learning for Response Tensors in Crystalline Magnets: Application to Kagome Metals
full_list.title_zh: 晶体磁体响应张量的物理信息机器学习：在 Kagome 金属中的应用
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22642v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The prediction of response tensors from magnetic textures is a crucial challenge in the study of noncollinear magnets. Existing methods for constructing descriptors of a given response tensor are limited to first-order multipole expansions or restricted to simple magnetic structures. In this work, we construct a complete symmetry-invariant descriptor basis for arbitrary crystal structures and magnetic textures, providing interpretable features for machine learning modeling of response tensors. We modify the standard principal component analysis framework and derive uncorrelated order parameters that are hierarchically stable: extending the order parameter space to include higher-degree spin order introduces additional order parameters that are uncorrelated to the previous ones. We apply this framework to regression and classification of the anomalous Hall conductivity (AHC) in a magnetic kagome lattice. In particular, in the regime where AHC is well modeled by linear regression of the symmetry-invariant order parameters, we find that the squared regression coefficients, ranked by their magnitude, obey a Zipf-like power law: βᵣ² propto r⁻α. Our method provides a systematic route to construct interpretable order parameters of all spin orders that connect the symmetry of a magnetic crystal to its response tensors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。特别是，在 AHC 通过对称不变阶参数的线性回归很好地建模的情况下，我们发现平方回归系数（按其大小排序）服从类似 Zipf 的幂律：βᵣ² propto r⁻α。我们的方法提供了一种系统的途径来构造所有自旋顺序的可解释的顺序参数，这些参数将磁性晶体的对称性与其响应张量联系起来。
full_list.summary: 从磁性纹理预测响应张量是非共线磁体研究中的一个关键挑战。用于构造给定响应张量的描述符的现有方法仅限于一阶多极展开或仅限于简单的磁结构。在这项工作中，我们为任意晶体结构和磁性纹理构建了完整的对称不变描述符基础，为响应张量的机器学习建模提供了可解释的特征。我们修改标准主成分分析框架并导出层次稳定的不相关阶次参数：扩展阶次参数空间以包含更高阶的自旋阶次引入与先前的阶次参数不相关的额外阶次参数。我们将该框架应用于磁 kagome 晶格中反常霍尔电导率 (AHC) 的回归和分类。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《晶体磁体响应张量的物理信息机器学习：在 Kagome 金属中的应用》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Electrified Metal-Water Interfaces at Constant Potential: Data-Efficient Transfer Learning for Machine-Learning-Based Molecular Dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 恒定电势的带电金属-水界面：基于机器学习的分子动力学的数据高效迁移学习
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2511.19338v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Simulating electrified metal-water interfaces with explicit solvent under constant potential is essential for understanding electrochemical processes, yet remains prohibitively expensive with ab initio methods. We present TRECI, a data-efficient workflow for constructing machine learning force-fields (ML-FFs) that achieve ab initio-level accuracy in electronically grand-canonical molecular dynamics. By leveraging transfer learning from general-purpose and domain-specific models, TRECI enables stable and accurate simulations across a wide potential range using a reduced number of reference configurations. This efficiency allows the use of high-level meta-GGA functionals and rigorous surface-electrification schemes. Applied to Cu(111)-water, models trained on just one thousand configurations yield accurate molecular dynamics simulations, capturing bias-dependent solvent restructuring effects not previously reported. TRECI offers a general strategy for characterising diverse materials and interfacial chemistries, significantly lowering the cost of realistic constant-potential simulations and expanding access to quantitative electrochemical modelling.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在恒定电势下用显式溶剂模拟带电金属-水界面对于理解电化学过程至关重要，但从头计算方法仍然非常昂贵。我们推出了 TRECI，这是一种数据高效的工作流程，用于构建机器学习力场 (ML-FF)，可在电子大规范分子动力学中实现从头开始的精度。通过利用通用和特定领域模型的迁移学习，TRECI 使用更少的参考配置在广泛的潜在范围内实现稳定和准确的模拟。这种效率允许使用高级元 GGA 函数和严格的表面电气化方案。

full_list.title_en: Reconstruction of Magnetic Fields with a Physics-Informed Neural Network
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Reconstruction of Magnetic Fields with a Physics-Informed Neural Network
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23691v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate reconstruction of magnetic fields and their gradients is essential for assessing and controlling systematic effects in precision measurement experiments. We have developed a physics-informed neural network (PINN) method which reconstructs three-dimensional magnetic fields subject to the source-free Maxwell equations, nablacdotB=0 and nablatimesB=0. In an extension of our previous work on PINN methods for reconstruction of magnetic fields in inaccessible interior regions via measurements at exterior locations, we now demonstrate the feasibility of applying PINN methods to the extraction of magnetic field gradient terms from discrete measurement points subject to constraints from Maxwell's equations.

full_list.title_en: Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Microscopic origin of polytype-dependent melting in SiC revealed by machine-learning molecular dynamics
full_list.abstract: Predicting how crystal structure influences high-temperature stability remains a key challenge in materials modeling and design. Silicon carbide (SiC), one of the most thermally and chemically stable materials known, provides an ideal system for studying this problem because its many polytypes preserve similar local tetrahedral bonding while differing in long-range stacking geometry. To determine the impact of polytype structure on the high-temperature stability of SiC, we combine phase-coexistence machine-learning molecular dynamics with finite-temperature phonon analysis, enabled by a fine-tuned MACE interatomic potential that accurately describes crystalline, high-temperature, and disordered configurations across multiple SiC polytypes. We identify a clear stability ordering, 3C > 2H > 9R, reflected consistently in structural disordering, interlayer sliding, and finite-temperature phonon spectra. Across all polytypes, melting initiates through the formation of short C–C contacts and carbon-rich local regions, followed by a progressive loss of tetrahedral Si–C connectivity. The reduced stability of the long-period 9R polytype is associated with a denser manifold of low-frequency transverse-acoustic modes arising from its stacking periodicity and associated zone folding, which broaden and soften further at high temperature. These modes can provide additional low-energy channels for thermally activated lateral bilayer motion, consistent with the larger sliding amplitudes observed in 9R and their positive correlation with local structural disorder.

full_list.title_en: Automated end-station at the soft X-ray beamline featuring robotic air-to-ultrahigh-vacuum sample transfer, scanning probe spectroscopy, and machine learning analysis
full_list.title_zh: 软 X 射线束线的自动化终端站具有机器人空气到超高真空样品传输、扫描探针光谱和机器学习分析功能
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22384v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Driven by the growing integration of artificial intelligence and robotics in experimental science, we redefine the execution of user experiments at synchrotron soft X-ray beamlines by developing a highly automated end-station that can be operated without on-site staff. Installed at beamline BL08U of NanoTerasu, the system comprises four chamber units and two robots that automatically transfer samples from ambient air to an ultrahigh vacuum measurement stage for spectroscopic evaluations, before returning them to their original locations post-measurement. Soft X-ray absorption spectra are automatically acquired once programmed by scanning the micro-focused beam over the designated sample area, followed by automated evaluation using machine learning techniques such as principal-component analysis, multidimensional scaling, t-distributed stochastic neighbour embedding, and uniform manifold approximation and projection. The high-throughput data are systematically accumulated in the database for remote user examination. This unstaffed end-station provides efficient beamtime for users and allows beamline scientists/technicians to pursue more human and creative endeavors.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在人工智能和机器人技术在实验科学中日益融合的推动下，我们通过开发无需现场工作人员即可操作的高度自动化终端站，重新定义了同步加速器软 X 射线束线的用户实验的执行。该系统安装在 NanoTerasu 的光束线 BL08U 上，由四个室单元和两个机器人组成，可自动将样品从环境空气转移到超高真空测量台进行光谱评估，然后在测量后将样品返回到原始位置。

full_list.title_en: Learning the self-energy through equivariant neural networks
full_list.title_zh: 通过等变神经网络学习自能量
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic self-energy determines the single-particle Green's function and, through it, quasiparticle energies and spectral functions, but computing it from first principles is expensive and it is a difficult machine-learning target: complex-valued, matrix-valued in a local-orbital basis, and dependent on a continuous frequency. We predict the dynamical correlation part of the imaginary-frequency G₀W₀ self-energy matrix of molecules from atomic species and coordinates with an E(3)-equivariant message-passing network, the rotational covariance of the orbital-space matrix being imposed by the architecture itself and the static exchange part taken from the density-functional reference. Frequency enters either as an explicit network input or through frequency-specific output heads, and the predicted matrices are continued to the real axis in a representation in which causality and a non-negative spectral density hold by construction. The frequency-conditioned model reproduces matrix elements to below 1 meV on the imaginary axis for the systems studied here, and that accuracy survives the continuation: for water clusters, including a tetramer absent from the training set, and for chemically diverse molecules from QM9, the reconstructed spectral functions follow the G₀W₀ reference peak by peak and the frontier quasiparticle levels are recovered to a few tens of meV. Learning the self-energy on the imaginary axis is therefore a practical route to real-frequency spectra: once the model is trained, and given the density-functional reference it is built on, a new geometry costs no explicit G₀W₀ calculation.
full_list.abstract_zh: 电子自能决定了单粒子格林函数，并通过它决定了准粒子能量和谱函数，但从第一原理计算它的成本很高，而且它是一个困难的机器学习目标：复值、局部轨道基础上的矩阵值，并且依赖于连续频率。我们预测了来自原子种类的分子的虚频 G₀W₀ 自能矩阵的动态相关部分，并与 E(3) 等变消息传递网络进行协调，轨道空间矩阵的旋转协方差由结构本身施加，静态交换部分取自密度泛函参考。频率作为显式网络输入或通过特定于频率的输出头进入，并且预测矩阵以因果关系和非负谱密度通过构造保持的表示延续至实轴。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 电子自能决定了单粒子格林函数，并通过它决定了准粒子能量和谱函数，但从第一原理计算它的成本很高，而且它是一个困难的机器学习目标：复值、局部轨道基础上的矩阵值，并且依赖于连续频率。我们预测了来自原子种类的分子的虚频 G₀W₀ 自能矩阵的动态相关部分，并与 E(3) 等变消息传递网络进行协调，轨道空间矩阵的旋转协方差由结构本身施加，静态交换部分取自密度泛函参考。频率作为显式网络输入或通过特定于频率的输出头进入，并且预测矩阵以因果关系和非负谱密度通过构造保持的表示延续至实轴。对于此处研究的系统，频率条件模型将虚轴上的矩阵元素复制到低于 1 meV，并且该精度在延续中得以保留：对于水簇（包括训练集中不存在的四聚体）以及来自 QM9 的化学不同分子，重建的光谱函数遵循 G₀W₀ 参考峰逐峰，并且前沿准粒子水平恢复到几十 meV。因此，学习虚轴上的自能是获得真实频谱的实用途径：一旦模型经过训练，并给定其所建立的密度泛函参考，新的几何形状就不需要显式的 G₀W₀ 计算。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《通过等变神经网络学习自能量》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.24073v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) require generating computationally expensive, large-scale training datasets to accurately simulate materials and molecules. Incorporating electronic structure information using multitask learning improves sample efficiency, however, training on full Hamiltonian matrices, which scale quadratically with the number of atoms, is intractable for large datasets. In this work, we show that multitask learning utilizing orbitally resolved semiempirical charges significantly improves sample efficiency and accuracy in MLIPs. To efficiently predict orbital charges, we implement a specialized equivariant model, reducing charge prediction error compared to an invariant baseline. By augmenting training with computationally inexpensive GFN1-xTB orbital charges, which scale linearly with the number of atoms, our model achieves a 58% reduction in energy mean absolute error relative to energy-only baselines, and requires five times less data to match their performance. Against the stronger baseline of joint energy-and-force training, orbital charges still reduce the energy error by 12%. Furthermore, our approach matches or outperforms models trained on expensive density functional theory (DFT) atomic charges, capturing orbitally resolved electronic complexity and forcing the network to learn a physically accurate latent space that spontaneously clusters metals by shared chemical properties. Because orbital charges are only required during training, this approach preserves inference efficiency, providing a scalable recipe for developing accurate, data-efficient foundation models for complex chemical systems.

full_list.title_en: Spatial statistics for screening molecular structures
full_list.title_zh: 用于筛选分子结构的空间统计
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2605.17147v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The dominant paradigm in computational materials discovery relies on heavily parameterized deep architectures, including message-passing graph networks and equivariant models, that require millions of DFT-labeled training structures and produce non-convex latent representations that complicate continuous optimization for inverse design. These architectures are impractical in data-scarce regimes, which is the typical case in molecular screening, and exhibit well-documented limitations in capturing chemically disordered configurations and chiral geometries. This review presents feature engineering based on spatial statistics as a physically rigorous and immediately deployable alternative. Molecular structures are encoded as voxelized scalar fields, and two-point auto- and cross-correlations are evaluated deterministically via Fast Fourier Transforms, explicitly transferring the burden of spatial pattern recognition from the learning algorithm to a closed-form, physics-informed operation. Principal component analysis of the resulting correlation maps yields low-dimensional, strictly convex representations that support lean neural networks (<100k trainable parameters) and non-parametric surrogate models, achieving sub-2% prediction error with as few as 10 training samples. Demonstrated across periodic crystals, chemically disordered high-entropy alloys, and non-periodic organic molecules, this framework enables Bayesian active learning and zero-shot extrapolation on commodity hardware, which current large-scale architectures cannot replicate at equivalent data budgets.
full_list.abstract_zh: 计算材料发现的主导范式依赖于高度参数化的深度架构，包括消息传递图网络和等变量模型，这些架构需要数百万个DFT标记的训练结构，并产生非凸潜在表示，从而使逆向设计的连续优化复杂化。这些架构在数据稀缺的情况下是不切实际的，这是分子筛选的典型情况，并且在捕获化学无序配置和手性几何形状方面表现出有据可查的局限性。本综述将基于空间统计的特征工程作为一种物理严谨且可立即部署的替代方案。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 计算材料发现的主导范式依赖于高度参数化的深度架构，包括消息传递图网络和等变量模型，这些架构需要数百万个DFT标记的训练结构，并产生非凸潜在表示，从而使逆向设计的连续优化复杂化。这些架构在数据稀缺的情况下是不切实际的，这是分子筛选的典型情况，并且在捕获化学无序配置和手性几何形状方面表现出有据可查的局限性。本综述将基于空间统计的特征工程作为一种物理严谨且可立即部署的替代方案。分子结构被编码为体素化标量场，并通过快速傅里叶变换确定性地评估两点自相关和互相关，明确地将空间模式识别的负担从学习算法转移到封闭形式的物理信息操作。由此产生的相关图的主成分分析产生了支持精益神经网络（ < 100k可训练参数）和非参数代理模型的低维、严格凸表示，只需10个训练样本即可实现低于2%的预测误差。该框架在周期性晶体、化学无序高熵合金和非周期性有机分子上进行了演示，实现了贝叶斯主动学习和商品硬件上的零点外推，目前的大规模架构无法以等效的数据预算进行复制。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 主动学习和高通量采样，以及晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《用于筛选分子结构的空间统计》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: From Atomistic Impurity Landscapes to Two-Level-System Distributions and Microwave Loss: Hydrogen-Induced Losses in Nb₂O₅₋δ and Ta₂O₅₋δ
full_list.title_zh: 从原子杂质景观到两能级系统分布和微波损耗：Nb2O5₋δ 和 Ta2O5₋δ 中氢引起的损耗
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.17194v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We introduce a first-principles-guided framework for predicting statistical TLS distributions from mobile impurities in disordered materials. Machine-learned interatomic potentials, with DFT and minimum-action-path validation, connect impurity landscapes to tunnel-splitting and asymmetry distributions, TLS densities, and dielectric loss. Applied to amorphous Nb₂O₅₋δ and Ta₂O₅₋δ, the framework implicates interstitial hydrogen as a source of microwave loss. Loss tangents match Nb-pentoxide measurements at inferred H concentrations, while weaker H uptake in Ta reproduces the Nb/Ta TLS contrast.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们引入了一个第一原理指导框架，用于预测无序材料中移动杂质的统计TLS分布。通过DFT和最小作用路径验证，机器学习的原子间电位将杂质景观连接到隧道分裂和不对称分布、TLS密度和介电损耗。该框架适用于非晶态Nb ₂ O恤δ和Ta ₂ O恤δ ，暗示间隙氢是微波损耗的来源。在推断的H浓度下，损耗切线与Nb-五氧化二氮测量值相匹配，而Ta中较弱的H吸收再现了Nb/Ta TLS对比度。

full_list.title_en: Thermal Conductivity and Temperature-Induced Band Gap Renormalization in Crystalline and Amorphous Ga₂O₃
full_list.title_zh: 晶体和非晶 Ga2O3 的热导率和温度引起的带隙重正化
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.29484v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The lattice thermal conductivity (LTC) and electron-phonon interactions in crystalline and amorphous gallium oxide are herein determined by coupling a machine-learned interatomic potential, namely the moment tensor potential (MTP) model, to first-principles calculations. Crystalline β-Ga₂O₃ exhibits a substantial band gap renormalization (BGR) of sim0.45 eV at 700 K, with sim0.2 eV caused by zero-point BGR. The computed temperature dependence of BGR induced by classical nuclear motion in β-Ga₂O₃ is stronger than that in amorphous Ga₂O₃, with the difference in BGR reaching sim0.18 eV at 900 K. Thermal transport calculations reveal that the LTC of amorphous Ga₂O₃ remains near 0.9 W· m⁻¹·K⁻¹ for temperatures between 300 K and 700 K, which is approximately an order of magnitude lower than that of crystalline β-Ga₂O₃. Overall, the presented framework provides a computationally tractable and reliable route for predicting properties of semiconductors (both crystalline and amorphous) under operating conditions relevant to microelectronics and optoelectronics.

full_list.title_en: The effect of oxygen on the surface tension of AlTi metallic alloys

full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23286v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We perform molecular dynamics (MD) simulations of AlTi metallic alloy melts, with a specific focus on surface properties and the effect of oxygen. The simulations use a machine-learned inter- action potential (MLIP) that has recently been tested through experimental data for the statical and dynamical properties of AlTi melts in the bulk [Kato et al. (2026)]. We find that the surface- tension response to oxygen depends strongly on the AlTi composition. Element-resolved density profiles show that oxygen enrichment near the interface is accompanied by a suppression of the Al surface segregation observed in the oxygen-free liquid. The results are compared to experimental values obtained using levitation techniques in microgravity.

full_list.title_en: ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：ADT: All-Atom Diffusion Tokenizer for 3D Molecular Structures
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23265v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Discrete structural tokenization provides a promising route to autoregressive 3D molecular generation. Yet, existing tokenizers face a trade-off between compact representation and all-atom reconstruction: atom-level tokens preserve atomic details but produce long sequences, while compact residue-level protein tokens typically omit side-chain geometry. To overcome this limitation, we propose All-atom Diffusion Tokenizer (ADT), which decouples token granularity from reconstruction resolution. ADT uses one structural token per atom for small molecules and one token per protein residue that jointly represents backbone and side-chain geometry. To mitigate geometric distortion introduced by quantization, we leverage the generative capacity of diffusion models to recover fine-grained atomic geometry beyond deterministic decoding from discrete tokens. Extensive experiments across small molecules and proteins demonstrate that ADT achieves strong reconstruction from compact discrete representations while enabling high-quality autoregressive generation of both small molecules and all-atom protein structures. These results establish compact structural tokens as an effective discrete interface for all-atom molecular reconstruction and generation.

full_list.title_en: Angular compliance, not amplitude, governs the dielectric response of BaTiO3
full_list.title_zh: 角度顺应性，而不是振幅，决定了BaTiO3的介电响应
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.07219v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Soft-mode theory specifies a frequency, not what a local polar unit does. What real-space motion underlies the dielectric response of BaTiO3 therefore remains unclear. Using electric-field-induced molecular dynamics with a machine-learning force field, we show that the permittivity tracks the field-induced angular redistribution of local Ti-O off-centering, not its magnitude. Temperature and biaxial strain modify the local structure through different microscopic routes, yet both dielectric responses collapse onto a common relation with the same orientational descriptor, providing a real-space counterpart to soft-mode behavior.

full_list.title_en: A Topological Signature of Learning under Noisy Labels
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：A Topological Signature of Learning under Noisy Labels
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23491v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: How does noisy supervision change the representations learned by a neural network? Training accuracy measures agreement with training labels but provides little information about representation geometry. We use persistent homology to track loop structure across distance thresholds in neural activations. Experiments span image classification, text classification, and modular arithmetic. On a fixed CIFAR-10/ResNet-18 training probe, equally sized clean-label and corrupted-label subsets show no detectable persistence difference at epoch 10, whereas corrupted-label subsets have higher persistence at epoch 50. The contrast survives uniform-scale controls, even though predictions match the assigned noisy labels for only 7-11% of corrupted probe examples at that checkpoint. Normalisation preserves the crossover between clean and noisy training trajectories on CIFAR-10/ResNet-18, whereas CIFAR-100/ResNet-18 shows no crossover under any of the five evaluated constructions. In a separate noise-rate calibration comparison across five pipelines, mean activation norm achieves a higher mean in-sample R2 than raw persistence (0.936 versus 0.908). These findings show that noisy supervision leaves a measurable geometric signature even when agreement with corrupted labels is low. Comparing persistence under scale controls with label-fitting measurements offers a way to study how representations respond to label corruption beyond what training accuracy reveals.

full_list.title_en: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
full_list.title_zh: 通过交变磁邻近工程设计半导体中的非相对论自旋分裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped d-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. Crucially, the induced nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings exhibit qualitatively different dependences on band alignment. Virtual processes involving the valence and conduction bands of the altermagnet can reinforce the altermagnetic splitting while contributing with opposite signs to the interfacial Rashba coupling. Consequently, electrostatic tuning can access a regime in which the Rashba splitting vanishes while a sizable d-wave spin splitting persists. Exact diagonalization of the full heterostructure model confirms the analytical theory and establishes the robustness of this mechanism beyond the perturbative regime. Our results identify altermagnetic proximity as a route for engineering nonrelativistic spin-split electronic states in established semiconductor platforms, providing a general strategy for disentangling magnetic and relativistic spin interactions in quantum heterostructures.
full_list.abstract_zh: 交变磁体将消失的净磁化强度与动量相关的非相对论性自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子学和量子器件提供了有吸引力的功能。然而，它们的实际应用受到同时具有所需的交磁对称性、半导体电子结构和弱自旋轨道耦合的材料的有限可用性的限制。在这里，我们表明，这些要求可以通过邻近工程在组成材料之间分开。我们开发了一种用于与带隙 d 波交变磁体耦合的传统半导体的分析理论，并证明虚拟隧道效应将交变磁体自旋分裂转移到半导体。至关重要的是，引起的非相对论性和相对论性自旋分裂表现出对能带排列的不同性质的依赖性。

full_list.title_en: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb₄Se₈
full_list.title_zh: 插层交流磁体 CoNb₄Se₈ 中终止相关的表面费米学
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb₄Se₈, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.
full_list.abstract_zh: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交变磁体最近仍因其具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接了解它们的电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使观察到的特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误解为体带的自旋分裂对应物。这个问题对于层状插层系统尤其重要，其中具有不同终端的微米大小的域通常共存于劈裂表面上。我们讨论 CoNb₄Se₈ 的这种情况，CoNb₄Se₈ 是最早建立的层状交流磁体之一。

full_list.title_en: Coherent phonons in photoexcited semiconductors from first principles
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Coherent phonons in photoexcited semiconductors from first principles
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22901v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Coherent phonons are phase-locked lattice vibrations that provide a sensitive probe of nonequilibrium dynamics in materials. Existing first-principles equation-of-motion (EOM) approaches have successfully described coherent phonons in metals and semimetals, but their extension to semiconductors requires treating the long-lived electron--hole plasma created by above-gap excitation. Here we extend the first-principles EOM framework to photoexcited semiconductors by incorporating the residual plasma force that shifts the lattice equilibrium together with the plasma-induced renormalization of the electronic structure. For monolayer MoTe₂, the calculated carrier-density-dependent Te displacement agrees with constrained density-functional perturbation theory only when the renormalized band structure is included. We then show that increasing the photoexcited carrier density enhances both the initial total force and the plasma-shifted equilibrium position of the A₁g mode, producing larger coherent lattice oscillations. This density-controlled response appears in both the atomic displacement and the coherent-phonon-induced band renormalization, providing complementary signatures for ultrafast reflectivity and time- and angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy.

full_list.title_en: Higher-Dimensional Information Lattice: Quantum State Characterization through Inclusion-Exclusion Local Information
full_list.title_zh: 高维信息晶格：通过包含-排除局部信息表征量子态
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2512.20793v2 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Developing a local description of quantum information is a central problem in quantum many-body physics: the goal is to identify how correlations are organized across positions and scales without choosing specific observables. We introduce a higher-dimensional information lattice, an inclusion-exclusion construction that decomposes the von Neumann information of reduced density matrices into contributions labeled by subsystem position and scale. Above one dimension, overlapping subsystems can form loops, allowing information associated with one subsystem to be inferred nonlocally from the density matrices of others. The sign of the inclusion-exclusion information resolves such overlap redundancies in position and scale: positive values mark positions and scales with net information gain, while negative values occur where redundant contributions dominate new ones. We implement the construction in two dimensions and apply it to many-body ground states with distinct entanglement structures. For localized states, such as disordered-localized states or gapped ground states of local Hamiltonians, the local information decays exponentially along different directions, defining direction-dependent information length scales. In critical states with a Fermi surface, decay becomes algebraic, with dominant directions tied to the velocity of gapless modes. In the toric code, topological order manifests as a negative information value at the largest lattice scale, interpreted as global information redundancy between the smallest loop-enclosing overlapping subsystems. We also isolate the universal information carried by edge states and locate the signatures of non-Abelian fusion channels in position and scale. Our results establish the higher-dimensional information lattice as a framework for resolving universal correlation structures through the spatial and scale distribution of quantum information.
full_list.abstract_zh: 开发量子信息的局部描述是量子多体物理学的一个中心问题：目标是确定如何在不选择特定可观测值的情况下跨位置和尺度组织相关性。我们引入了一种高维信息格，一种包含排除结构，它将约化密度矩阵的冯·诺依曼信息分解为由子系统位置和规模标记的贡献。在一维之上，重叠的子系统可以形成循环，从而允许从其他子系统的密度矩阵非局部地推断与一个子系统相关的信息。包含-排除信息的符号解决了位置和规模上的重叠冗余：正值用净信息增益标记位置和规模，而负值出现在冗余贡献主导新贡献的情况下。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 开发量子信息的局部描述是量子多体物理学的一个中心问题：目标是确定如何在不选择特定可观测值的情况下跨位置和尺度组织相关性。我们引入了一种高维信息格，一种包含排除结构，它将约化密度矩阵的冯·诺依曼信息分解为由子系统位置和规模标记的贡献。在一维之上，重叠的子系统可以形成循环，从而允许从其他子系统的密度矩阵非局部地推断与一个子系统相关的信息。包含-排除信息的符号解决了位置和规模上的重叠冗余：正值用净信息增益标记位置和规模，而负值出现在冗余贡献主导新贡献的情况下。我们在二维上实现了该结构，并将其应用于具有不同纠缠结构的多体基态。对于局域态，例如无序局域态或局部哈密顿量的有隙基态，局部信息沿不同方向呈指数衰减，从而定义了方向相关的信息长度尺度。在费米面的临界状态下，衰变变成代数的，其主导方向与无间隙模式的速度相关。在环面代码中，拓扑顺序表现为最大晶格尺度上的负信息值，解释为最小循环封闭重叠子系统之间的全局信息冗余。我们还隔离了边缘状态携带的通用信息，并在位置和尺度上定位非阿贝尔融合通道的特征。我们的结果建立了高维信息晶格作为通过量子信息的空间和尺度分布来解决普遍相关结构的框架。

full_list.title_en: Scaling of entanglement with distance between subsystems: detection of phase transitions in the t'-π-flux model
full_list.title_zh: 纠缠与子系统之间距离的缩放：检测 t'-π-通量模型中的相变
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23770v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The system-size scaling of bipartite entanglement can be used to detect phase transitions. We develop a related approach for strongly correlated electron models where large density matrices or large system size scaling are inaccessible. To this end, we demonstrate that phase transitions of various kinds are signaled by a sharp signature in the first- or second-order logarithmic derivatives of the negativity measuring entanglement between small clusters at varying distances. Crucially, we show how to mitigate the effect of quantum Monte Carlo noise at large distances when computing the negativity. Our focus is on the t'-π-flux Hubbard model using auxiliary-field quantum Monte Carlo simulations. It has the particular advantage of showing three distinct phase transitions in a single model: semimetal to band insulator, semimetal to antiferromagnetic Mott insulator, and a magnetic order-disorder transition belonging to the Gaussian, Gross-Neveu, and O(3) Wilson-Fisher universality classes, respectively.
full_list.abstract_zh: 二分纠缠的系统尺寸缩放可用于检测相变。我们为强相关电子模型开发了一种相关方法，其中无法访问大密度矩阵或大系统尺寸缩放。为此，我们证明了各种相变是由负性的一阶或二阶对数导数中的尖锐特征来表示的，测量不同距离的小团簇之间的纠缠。至关重要的是，我们展示了在计算负性时如何减轻远距离量子蒙特卡罗噪声的影响。我们的重点是使用辅助场量子蒙特卡罗模拟的 t'-π-通量哈伯德模型。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 二分纠缠的系统尺寸缩放可用于检测相变。我们为强相关电子模型开发了一种相关方法，其中无法访问大密度矩阵或大系统尺寸缩放。为此，我们证明了各种相变是由负性的一阶或二阶对数导数中的尖锐特征来表示的，测量不同距离的小团簇之间的纠缠。至关重要的是，我们展示了在计算负性时如何减轻远距离量子蒙特卡罗噪声的影响。我们的重点是使用辅助场量子蒙特卡罗模拟的 t'-π-通量哈伯德模型。它的独特优势是在单个模型中显示三种不同的相变：半金属到带状绝缘体、半金属到反铁磁莫特绝缘体，以及分别属于高斯、Gross-Neveu 和 O(3) Wilson-Fisher 普适性类的磁有序-无序转变。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：蒙特卡洛统计采样，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: Sub-Landau levels in two-dimensional electron system in magnetic field
full_list.title_zh: 磁场中二维电子系统的亚朗道能级
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2406.06212v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We study two interacting electrons in a two-dimensional system under a strong magnetic field and show that their numerically exact solutions organize into a set of em sub-Landau levels characterized by relative angular momentum quantum number m. These sub-levels define correlation-resolved subspaces of the Landau-level Hilbert space, while retaining the full degeneracy associated with center-of-mass motion. Within this structure, the accessible states in each correlation channel are effectively reduced, leading to a natural organization of guiding-center states consistent with a fractional occupancy. We further analyze the role of electron correlation, Zeeman splitting, and disorder in stabilizing spin-polarized electron-pair states. Building on the two-electron states, we construct a class of many-electron trial wavefunctions based on correlated electron pairs with fixed m, which encode short-range correlations through the vanishing of the pair wavefunction at small separation. Our results establish a direct connection between exact two-body physics and the organization of correlated many-electron states in the lowest Landau level, providing a microscopic perspective on how relative angular momentum structures can underpin the emergence of correlated phases in quantum Hall systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了强磁场下二维系统中两个相互作用的电子，并表明它们的数值精确解组织成一组以相对角动量量子数 m 为特征的 em 亚朗道能级。这些子级别定义了朗道级希尔伯特空间的相关解析子空间，同时保留与质心运动相关的完全简并性。在这种结构中，每个相关通道中的可访问状态被有效地减少，从而导致与分数占用一致的引导中心状态的自然组织。我们进一步分析了电子关联、塞曼分裂和无序在稳定自旋极化电子对态中的作用。

full_list.title_en: Valley-Selective Transport through Structural Domain Walls in Rhombohedral Graphene Quarter Metals
full_list.title_zh: 菱面体石墨烯季金属中结构畴壁的谷选择性传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22521v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Domain walls separating quarter metals with opposite valley polarizations have recently been imaged in rhombohedral graphene multilayers. Depending on their formation mechanism, these walls respond in distinct ways to external magnetic probes. Therefore, understanding their behaviors is critical to the interpretation of experimental results. In this work, we examine domain walls formed from strain-induced one-dimensional structural defects that separate domains with complementary rhombohedral stacking orders. We show that while transport across such domain walls is controlled by the valley degree of freedom, the coupling to a magnetic field is dictated by the momentum-space chirality encoded in the Hamiltonian. As a consequence, structural domain walls are rendered electronically opaque by an applied magnetic field, while intrinsic domain walls formed by spontaneous valley symmetry breaking are unstable in the presence of such an ordering field and can be eliminated. This dichotomy allows the two types of domain walls to be distinguished in a magnetotransport experiment.
full_list.abstract_zh: 最近在菱面体石墨烯多层中成像了将具有相反谷极化的四分之一金属分开的畴壁。根据它们的形成机制，这些壁以不同的方式响应外部磁探针。因此，了解它们的行为对于解释实验结果至关重要。在这项工作中，我们检查了由应变引起的一维结构缺陷形成的畴壁，这些缺陷将具有互补菱面体堆叠顺序的畴分开。我们表明，虽然穿过这种畴壁的传输是由谷自由度控制的，但与磁场的耦合是由哈密顿量中编码的动量空间手性决定的。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 最近在菱面体石墨烯多层中成像了将具有相反谷极化的四分之一金属分开的畴壁。根据它们的形成机制，这些壁以不同的方式响应外部磁探针。因此，了解它们的行为对于解释实验结果至关重要。在这项工作中，我们检查了由应变引起的一维结构缺陷形成的畴壁，这些缺陷将具有互补菱面体堆叠顺序的畴分开。我们表明，虽然穿过这种畴壁的传输是由谷自由度控制的，但与磁场的耦合是由哈密顿量中编码的动量空间手性决定的。因此，结构畴壁通过施加的磁场而变得电子不透明，而由自发谷对称破缺形成的本征畴壁在存在这种有序场的情况下是不稳定的并且可以被消除。这种二分法允许在磁输运实验中区分两种类型的畴壁。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《菱面体石墨烯季金属中结构畴壁的谷选择性传输》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Dirac branch-cut modes with relativistic transport
full_list.title_zh: 具有相对论输运的狄拉克分支切割模式
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2603.28127v4 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Emergent Dirac fields, exhibiting effective relativistic physics, are most commonly associated with bulk and surface states in materials such as graphene and topological insulators. Here we show that phase dislocations of a complex Dirac mass support a distinct family of propagating Dirac defect states that behave as massless or massive one-dimensional relativistic modes. These traveling-wave defect states, termed Dirac branch-cut (DBC) modes, are governed by a one-dimensional Dirac Hamiltonian whose effective mass is controlled by the phase difference across the branch cut. Using acoustic metamaterials, we experimentally demonstrate a range of relativistic phenomena exhibited by DBC modes, including relativistic dispersion, energy-independent confinement, Klein tunnelling, and transport along freeform (e.g., spiral) trajectories. Our results establish branch-cut defects as a distinct platform for realizing propagating Dirac defect states, extending relativistic Dirac physics from bulk and surface states to propagating modes confined to defect boundaries.
full_list.abstract_zh: 涌现狄拉克场表现出有效的相对论物理学，最常与石墨烯和拓扑绝缘体等材料的体态和表面态相关。在这里，我们证明复杂狄拉克质量的相位错支持一系列独特的传播狄拉克缺陷态，这些缺陷态表现为无质量或大量一维相对论模式。这些行波缺陷态被称为狄拉克分支切割（DBC）模式，由一维狄拉克哈密顿量控制，其有效质量由分支切割上的相位差控制。使用声学超材料，我们通过实验证明了 DBC 模式所表现出的一系列相对论现象，包括相对论色散、能量无关限制、克莱因隧道效应和沿自由形式（例如螺旋）轨迹的传输。

full_list.title_en: Failure of the mean-field Hartree approximation for a bosonic many-body system with non-Hermitian Hamiltonian
full_list.title_zh: 具有非厄米哈密顿量的玻色多体系统的平均场 Hartree 近似失效
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.13038v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: Mean-field Hartree theory is a central tool for reducing many-body dynamics to an effective one-particle evolution. This approximation has been employed when the Hamiltonian governing the many-body dynamics is not Hermitian. Indeed, non-Hermitian Hamiltonians model particle gain/loss or the evolution of open quantum systems between consecutive quantum jumps. Furthermore, the validity of the Hartree approximation for generic non-Hermitian Hamiltonians lies at the basis of a quantum algorithm for nonlinear differential equations. In this work, we show that this approximation can fail. First, we consider the most general bosonic mean-field Hamiltonian with two-body interactions and we prove that, for non-Hermitian Hamiltonian, the Hartree equation does not capture the correct second time derivative of the one-particle marginal state at t=0 in the thermodynamic limit. Then, we analytically solve a model of N bosonic qubits with a purely anti-Hermitian Hamiltonian, compute the limit for N→infty of the one-particle marginal state and show that it does not agree with the solution of the non-Hermitian Hartree equation. We further show that there exists an initial condition such that the exact one-particle marginal state undergoes a finite-time transition to a mixed state, a phenomenon that is completely absent in the case of Hermitian Hamiltonians. Finally, we simulate a non-Hermitian Hamiltonian with real spectrum and show that, also in this case, there are initial conditions for which the Hartree equation does not reproduce the correct one-particle marginal state in the limit N→infty. Our findings challenge the validity of the mean-field Hartree approximation for non-Hermitian Hamiltonians, and call for additional conditions for the validity of the mean-field regime to model the dynamics of particle gain and loss and the open-system dynamics in bosonic many-body systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 平均场哈特里理论是将多体动力学简化为有效的单粒子演化的核心工具。当控制多体动力学的哈密顿量不是埃尔米特量时，就采用了这种近似。事实上，非厄米哈密顿量可以模拟粒子增益/损失或连续量子跳跃之间开放量子系统的演化。此外，Hartree 近似对于一般非厄米哈密顿量的有效性在于非线性微分方程的量子算法的基础。在这项工作中，我们证明这种近似可能会失败。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 平均场哈特里理论是将多体动力学简化为有效的单粒子演化的核心工具。当控制多体动力学的哈密顿量不是埃尔米特量时，就采用了这种近似。事实上，非厄米哈密顿量可以模拟粒子增益/损失或连续量子跳跃之间开放量子系统的演化。此外，Hartree 近似对于一般非厄米哈密顿量的有效性在于非线性微分方程的量子算法的基础。在这项工作中，我们证明这种近似可能会失败。首先，我们考虑具有双体相互作用的最一般的玻色平均场哈密顿量，并证明，对于非厄米哈密顿量，Hartree 方程不能捕获热力学极限中 t=0 时单粒子边缘态的正确二阶时间导数。然后，我们用纯反厄米哈密顿量解析求解 N 个玻色子量子位的模型，计算单粒子边缘态 N→infty 的极限，并表明它与非厄米 Hartree 方程的解不一致。我们进一步表明，存在一个初始条件，使得精确的单粒子边缘状态经历有限时间过渡到混合状态，这种现象在厄米哈密顿量的情况下完全不存在。最后，我们用实谱模拟非厄米哈密顿量，并表明，同样在这种情况下，存在哈特里方程无法在极限 N→infty 中再现正确的单粒子边缘状态的初始条件。我们的研究结果对非厄米哈密顿量的平均场哈特里近似的有效性提出了挑战，并要求平均场体系的有效性需要额外的条件来模拟粒子增益和损失的动力学以及玻色多体系统中的开放系统动力学。

full_list.title_en: Electron--phonon matrix elements from eigenvalue projection within the projector augmented-wave method
full_list.title_zh: 投影仪增强波法中特征值投影的电子-声子矩阵元素
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2503.11013v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We present a finite-displacement approach to electron--phonon matrix elements that requires only eigenvalues and wave functions from the displaced calculations, for both norm-conserving pseudopotentials and the projector augmented-wave (PAW) method. Extending the eigenvalue-projectability approach, previously formulated for norm-conserving pseudopotentials, we reconstruct the displaced Hamiltonian from the displaced eigenvalues and from overlaps evaluated in the PAW metric of each displaced structure. Analytic terms constructed from the PAW dataset then yield the all-electron matrix element, without derivatives of the local potential or of the PAW strengths. The approach therefore applies in principle to any electronic-structure method available in PAW. To reduce the supercell cost, we combine it with nondiagonal supercells that sample the Brillouin zone equivalently to the primitive cell and recover the full matrix elements by crystal symmetry. Implemented in the ARES-EPC code, the method reproduces matrix elements from density-functional perturbation theory and from VASP+phelel for seven materials with mean absolute errors below 0.5 meV. Nondiagonal supercells reproduce the diagonal-supercell results to the same accuracy and reduce the cost of the displaced calculations by up to a factor of 23.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们提出了一种电子声子矩阵元素的有限位移方法，对于范数守恒赝势和投影增强波（PAW）方法，仅需要来自位移计算的特征值和波函数。扩展了先前为范数守恒赝势制定的特征值可投影方法，我们根据置换的特征值和每个置换结构的 PAW 度量中评估的重叠来重建置换的哈密顿量。然后，根据 PAW 数据集构建的分析项会生成全电子矩阵元素，而无需局部势或 PAW 强度的导数。因此，该方法原则上适用于 PAW 中可用的任何电子结构方法。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们提出了一种电子声子矩阵元素的有限位移方法，对于范数守恒赝势和投影增强波（PAW）方法，仅需要来自位移计算的特征值和波函数。扩展了先前为范数守恒赝势制定的特征值可投影方法，我们根据置换的特征值和每个置换结构的 PAW 度量中评估的重叠来重建置换的哈密顿量。然后，根据 PAW 数据集构建的分析项会生成全电子矩阵元素，而无需局部势或 PAW 强度的导数。因此，该方法原则上适用于 PAW 中可用的任何电子结构方法。为了降低超晶胞成本，我们将其与非对角超晶胞结合起来，非对角超晶胞与原始晶胞等效地对布里渊区进行采样，并通过晶体对称性恢复完整的矩阵元素。该方法在 ARES-EPC 代码中实施，根据密度泛函微扰理论和 VASP+phelel 再现七种材料的矩阵元素，平均绝对误差低于 0.5 meV。非对角超晶胞以相同的精度重现对角超晶胞结果，并将置换计算的成本降低多达 23 倍。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的机器学习 Hamiltonian、带电缺陷形成能、缺陷扩散和非辐射复合嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在SiO₂、SiC、GaN、卤化物钙钛矿、HfO₂ 氧空位和二维半导体中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电荷态、有限尺寸修正、局域配位和缺陷迁移路径纳入标注；用小超胞 DFT+U/GW 或缺陷形成能基准校准，再扩展到大超胞和有限温度扩散”补充训练/验证集，再比较《投影仪增强波法中特征值投影的电子-声子矩阵元素》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: QMBL: the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard. A live record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians
full_list.title_zh: QMBL：量子多体排行榜。已发表的晶格哈密顿量基态能量的实时记录
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22387v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In condensed matter physics, scientists explore phase diagrams of matter through various methods (analysis, numerics, experiment) and achieve consensus when enough methods agree. The quality of variational results for quantum many-body ground states is mainly judged by energy values and respective errors. Here, we present QMBL, the Quantum Many-Body Leaderboard (https://www.qmbl.org), serving as the energy layer of the scientific consensus. It is a maintained, interactive record of published ground-state energies for lattice Hamiltonians. The latest release v0.4.0 holds 1434 energies on 395 instances of six model families and collects all of the community's efforts into one view. Of those instances 153 have no exact solution and any new record serves as a direct improvement to an open science problem. They are the targets of a companion benchmark, QMBL: Open Problems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 在凝聚态物理学中，科学家通过各种方法（分析、数值、实验）探索物质的相图，并在足够多的方法一致时达成共识。量子多体基态变分结果的好坏主要通过能量值和各自的误差来判断。在这里，我们介绍 QMBL，量子多体排行榜 (https://www.qmbl.org)，作为科学共识的能量层。它是已发布的晶格哈密顿量基态能量的维护的交互式记录。最新版本 v0.4.0 在六个模型系列的 395 个实例上拥有 1434 个能量，并将社区的所有努力收集到一个视图中。

full_list.title_en: Anti-synchronized collective rotation in magnetic colloidal particles under rotating magnetic fields
full_list.title_zh: 旋转磁场下磁性胶体粒子的反同步集体旋转
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23784v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Collective synchronization is a common response of interacting magnetic particles subjected to rotating external fields. Here we demonstrate a distinct nonequilibrium state in a two-dimensional cluster of magnetic colloidal particles in which the ordered crystalline core rotates, on average, opposite to the direction of the applied rotating magnetic field, while the defect-rich outer region continues to rotate with the drive. We term this state anti-synchronized collective rotation. By combining structural, spectral, bond-resolved, and layer-resolved torque analyses, we show that anti-synchronization is associated with a broader defect-rich interface, enhanced and dynamically heterogeneous bond deformation, and a reorganization of torque transmission between the surface and the crystalline interior. In the synchronized state, steric torques compensate the opposing dipolar contribution in the outer core, maintaining a positive net interaction torque. In the anti-synchronized state this compensation becomes insufficient, producing a negative net torque in theouter core and enabling core-surface rotational decoupling. Increasing the driving frequency restores coherent rotation through a transition characterized by competing positive- and negative-angular-velocity populations and hysteresis, consistent with a discontinuous, first-order-like dynamical transition. These results demonstrate how deformation and spatial redistribution of interaction torques can generate counter-rotating collective states in driven colloidal matter.
full_list.abstract_zh: 集体同步是相互作用的磁性粒子受到旋转外部场的常见响应。在这里，我们展示了二维磁性胶体颗粒簇中明显的非平衡状态，其中有序的晶体核心平均与所施加的旋转磁场的方向相反地旋转，而富含缺陷的外部区域继续随着驱动器旋转。我们将这种状态称为反同步集体轮换。通过结合结构、光谱、键分辨和层分辨扭矩分析，我们表明反同步与更广泛的缺陷丰富界面、增强的动态异质键变形以及表面和晶体内部之间扭矩传递的重组有关。在同步状态下，空间扭矩补偿外核中相反的偶极贡献，保持正的净相互作用扭矩。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 集体同步是相互作用的磁性粒子受到旋转外部场的常见响应。在这里，我们展示了二维磁性胶体颗粒簇中明显的非平衡状态，其中有序的晶体核心平均与所施加的旋转磁场的方向相反地旋转，而富含缺陷的外部区域继续随着驱动器旋转。我们将这种状态称为反同步集体轮换。通过结合结构、光谱、键分辨和层分辨扭矩分析，我们表明反同步与更广泛的缺陷丰富界面、增强的动态异质键变形以及表面和晶体内部之间扭矩传递的重组有关。在同步状态下，空间扭矩补偿外核中相反的偶极贡献，保持正的净相互作用扭矩。在反同步状态下，这种补偿变得不足，在外芯中产生负净扭矩，并使芯表面旋转解耦。增加驱动频率可通过以竞争的正角速度群体和负角速度群体以及滞后为特征的转变恢复相干旋转，这与不连续的一阶动态转变一致。这些结果证明了相互作用扭矩的变形和空间重新分布如何在驱动胶体物质中产生反向旋转的集体状态。

full_list.title_en: Chirality-resolved imaging of spin waves with a quantum spin
full_list.title_zh: 具有量子自旋的自旋波的手性分辨成像
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22867v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Spin waves carry their propagation direction in the handedness of their circularly polarized stray field, a property inaccessible to scalar magnetometers. In the Damon-Eshbach surface wave of an in-plane magnetized film, the dipolar field above the film rotates with a handedness fixed by the direction of travel. The nitrogen-vacancy (NV) centre in diamond is an intrinsic polarization analyser: a right-handed field about the NV axis drives one spin transition, and a left-handed field drives the other, in both the ground and the excited state. Here, we exploit the two excited-state transitions, which lie inside the spin-wave band of yttrium iron garnet (YIG), as a pair of chirality channels and image Damon-Eshbach waves in both directions. Because reflection from an etched boundary reverses the handedness, the incident and reflected waves appear as two lines in one spectrum and are imaged separately. In the ground state, the same rule applies, and the selected field drives Rabi oscillations, a route to chirality-selective control of the NV spin by magnons. Reading the two channels gives the direction of a spin wave at one point, without a phase reference. This advances chirality-resolved quantum sensing and provides insight into chiral spin-wave dynamics.
full_list.abstract_zh: 自旋波以其圆极化杂散场的旋向性传播其传播方向，这是标量磁力计无法获得的特性。在面内磁化薄膜的达蒙-埃什巴赫表面波中，薄膜上方的偶极场以由行进方向固定的旋向旋转。金刚石中的氮空位 (NV) 中心是一种本征偏振分析仪：围绕 NV 轴的右手场驱动一个自旋跃迁，左手场驱动另一个自旋跃迁，无论是在基态还是激发态。在这里，我们利用位于钇铁石榴石 (YIG) 自旋波段内的两个激发态跃迁作为一对手性通道，并对两个方向的 Damon-Eshbach 波进行成像。

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 缺陷、畴壁、成核和开关动力学在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《具有量子自旋的自旋波的手性分辨成像》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Coexistence of Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like behavior in La-doped antiferromagnetic CaMnO3
full_list.title_zh: La 掺杂反铁磁 CaMnO3 中格里菲斯相与超顺磁行为的共存
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22844v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The coexistence of a Griffiths phase and superparamagnetic-like short range interaction in a single-phase homogeneous manganite is of particular interest because it reveals multiple levels of magnetic clustering generated by disorder and competing exchange interactions. In bulk La₀.₁₉Ca₀.₈₁MnO₃, this unusual magnetic state develops in the antiferromagnetic regime, where A-site disorder strongly modifies the local magnetic landscape. Rietveld analysis confirms a single-phase orthorhombic structure, while magnetic measurements establish a Griffiths phase below TG = 280 K through the deviation from Curie-Weiss behavior. Superparamagnetic-like behavior persisting from 280 to 370 K further indicates that isolated magnetic clusters remain stable well into the nominally paramagnetic region. The presence of both phenomena highlights the crucial role of disorder-induced exchange randomness in stabilizing complex magnetic states in correlated perovskite oxides.
full_list.abstract_zh: 单相均质亚锰矿中格里菲斯相和类超顺磁性短程相互作用的共存特别令人感兴趣，因为它揭示了由无序和竞争性交换相互作用产生的多级磁性聚集。在块体 La₀.₁₉Ca₀.₈₁MnO₃ 中，这种不寻常的磁态在反铁磁态中发展，其中 A 位无序强烈改变了局部磁景观。 Rietveld 分析证实了单相正交结构，而磁测量则通过与居里-魏斯行为的偏差建立了低于 TG = 280 K 的格里菲斯相。从 280 到 370 K 持续存在的类超顺磁行为进一步表明，孤立的磁簇在名义上的顺磁区域中保持稳定。

full_list.title_en: Comment on "Skyrmion Hall Effect in Altermagnets"
full_list.title_zh: 对“交变磁铁中的斯格明子霍尔效应”的评论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22486v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: In their Letter, Jin et al. [Phys. Rev. Lett. 133, 196701 (2024)] predict a transverse velocity v_y for skyrmions driven by spin-transfer torque (STT), known as skyrmion Hall effect (SkHE), in d-wave altermagnets. Usually, the SkHE emerges from the skyrmion's topological charge which here cancels between sublattices. Instead, Jin et al. attribute the SkHE to the dimensionless quadrupole tensor Aᵢⱼ. The result in their Eq. (12) is fitted to micromagnetic simulations, yielding a finite value for Aₓy. However, via the divergence theorem, Aᵢⱼ simplifies to a boundary integral that vanishes for a sufficiently smooth and localized texture. In this Comment, we substantiate our claim from Ref. [2] that the numerically observed SkHE by Jin et al. for a micromagnetic model with standard Zhang-Li STT in the individual sublattices is merely a discretization artefact.
full_list.abstract_zh: Jin 等人在信中。 [物理。莱特牧师。 133, 196701 (2024)] 预测 d 波交变磁体中由自旋转移矩 (STT) 驱动的斯格明子的横向速度 v_y，称为斯格明子霍尔效应 (SkHE)。通常，SkHE 源自斯格明子的拓扑电荷，此处在子晶格之间相互抵消。相反，金等人。将 SkHE 归因于无量纲四极张量 Aᵢⱼ。他们的方程的结果。 (12) 适合微磁模拟，产生 Aₓy 的有限值。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: Jin 等人在信中。 [物理。莱特牧师。 133, 196701 (2024)] 预测 d 波交变磁体中由自旋转移矩 (STT) 驱动的斯格明子的横向速度 v_y，称为斯格明子霍尔效应 (SkHE)。通常，SkHE 源自斯格明子的拓扑电荷，此处在子晶格之间相互抵消。相反，金等人。将 SkHE 归因于无量纲四极张量 Aᵢⱼ。他们的方程的结果。 (12) 适合微磁模拟，产生 Aₓy 的有限值。然而，通过散度定理，Aᵢⱼ 简化为边界积分，该边界积分对于足够平滑和局部化的纹理而言消失。在这篇评论中，我们证实了参考文献的主张。 [2] Jin 等人数值观测到的 SkHE。对于单个子晶格中具有标准张李 STT 的微磁模型来说，这只是一个离散化的人工制品。

full_list.title_en: Hidden Staggered Superconducting Order in V2Se2O-Family Altermagnets
full_list.title_zh: V2Se2O 系列交替磁体中隐藏的交错超导序
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22935v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: η pairing describes a staggered superconducting condensate whose order parameter changes sign between neighboring unit cells while maintaining a uniform magnitude. Nearly four decades after its theoretical proposal by C. N. Yang, a material platform for stabilizing η pairing has remained elusive. Here, we reveal that altermagnetism, despite being pair breaking for conventional BCS pairing, naturally favors η-like pairing in V₂Se₂O-family altermagnets. Their valley-contrasting spin structure gives rise to oppositely spin-polarized, symmetry-related valleys centered at X=(π,0) and Y=(0,π), which form spin-singlet pairing partners separated by the commensurate momentum mathbf Q=(π,π), thereby favoring an η-like condensate. Self-consistent calculations demonstrate that the resulting η-like state remains robust over broad variations of chemical potential, hopping parameters, and Fermi-surface topology. To detect this hidden staggered order, we propose a phase-sensitive Josephson measurement with a uniform superconductor, where destructive interference suppresses single-Cooper-pair tunneling while preserving two-Cooper-pair processes. This constitutes a charge-4e-like Josephson response despite a bulk condensate composed of charge-2e Cooper pairs, providing a direct phase-sensitive signature of the otherwise elusive η-like condensate in V₂Se₂O-family altermagnets.
full_list.abstract_zh: η配对描述了一种交错的超导凝聚体，其有序参数在相邻晶胞之间改变符号，同时保持均匀的大小。在杨振宁提出理论近四十年后，稳定 η 配对的材料平台仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了交变磁力，尽管对于传统的 BCS 配对来说是断对的，但它自然有利于 V2Se2O 族交变磁体中的类 η 配对。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: η配对描述了一种交错的超导凝聚体，其有序参数在相邻晶胞之间改变符号，同时保持均匀的大小。在杨振宁提出理论近四十年后，稳定 η 配对的材料平台仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了交变磁力，尽管对于传统的 BCS 配对来说是断对的，但它自然有利于 V2Se2O 族交变磁体中的类 η 配对。它们的谷对比自旋结构产生了以 X=(π,0) 和 Y=(0,π) 为中心的相反自旋极化、对称相关的谷，形成由相应动量 mathbf Q=(π,π) 分隔的自旋单重态配对伙伴，从而有利于形成类似 η 的凝聚态。自洽计算表明，所得到的类 η 态在化学势、跳跃参数和费米表面拓扑的广泛变化中保持稳健。为了检测这种隐藏的交错顺序，我们提出了一种具有均匀超导体的相敏约瑟夫森测量方法，其中相消干涉抑制了单库珀对隧道效应，同时保留了两库珀对过程。尽管大量凝聚态由电荷 2e 库珀对组成，但这仍构成电荷 4e 型约瑟夫森响应，为 V2Se2O 族交流磁体中难以捉摸的 η 型凝聚态提供了直接相敏特征。
full_list.summary: η配对描述了一种交错的超导凝聚体，其有序参数在相邻晶胞之间改变符号，同时保持均匀的大小。在杨振宁提出理论近四十年后，稳定 η 配对的材料平台仍然难以捉摸。在这里，我们揭示了交变磁力，尽管对于传统的 BCS 配对来说是断对的，但它自然有利于 V2Se2O 族交变磁体中的类 η 配对。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《V2Se2O 系列交替磁体中隐藏的交错超导序》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Intercalation of Ultrathin Ferromagnetic Iron Films at the Graphene/SiC Interface
full_list.title_zh: 石墨烯/SiC界面处超薄铁磁铁膜的插层
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23728v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The intercalation of high-quality PASG-grown (polymer-assisted sublimation growth) zero-layer graphene on 4H-SiC(0001) with iron is studied using a deposition-and-annealing approach. We find that unlike other metals, Fe does not easily intercalate, and the intercalation procedure has to be balanced with the formation of iron silicides and graphitic carbon at the interface. After successful intercalation, the ultrathin iron films are protected against oxidation by the covering graphene sheet, and retain ferromagnetic behaviour with an in-plane easy axis even at room temperature. When exposed to a selenium-rich atmosphere at elevated temperatures, an almost complete exchange of Fe by Se is observed, imposing a major restriction for the formation of multi-element 2D compounds via sequential intercalation schemes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 使用沉积和退火方法研究了用铁在 4H-SiC(0001) 上插入高质量 PASG 生长（聚合物辅助升华生长）零层石墨烯。我们发现，与其他金属不同，Fe 不容易嵌入，并且嵌入过程必须与界面处硅化铁和石墨碳的形成相平衡。成功嵌入后，覆盖的石墨烯片可以保护超薄铁膜免受氧化，并且即使在室温下也能保持具有面内易轴的铁磁行为。当在高温下暴露于富硒气氛时，观察到 Fe 几乎完全被 Se 交换，这对通过顺序插层方案形成多元素二维化合物施加了主要限制。

full_list.title_en: Kitaev, semi-Dirac, and spinon quantum spin Hall liquids on the square-hexagon-dodecagon lattice: A parent projective symmetry group classification
full_list.title_zh: 正方形-六边形-十二边形晶格上的基塔耶夫、半狄拉克和自旋量子自旋霍尔液体：父射影对称群分类
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22965v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The square-hexagon-dodecagon (SHD) lattice hosts an exactly solvable Kitaev spin liquid, while further-neighbor couplings frustrate its Heisenberg magnet into classically degenerate lines where quantum fluctuations can melt the Néel order. To place this state among the lattice's spin liquids, we classify fermionic parton mean-field states with singlet and spin-orbit-coupled triplet amplitudes by their projective symmetry groups (PSGs). As SHD sites lack site symmetry, its Z₂ PSGs are the projective classes of p6mm with time reversal, from which those of every single-orbit p6mm lattice follow. In the idealized Kitaev model, where lattice operations do not rotate spins, these liquids carry a single Z₂ PSG descending from the SU(2) Lieb-flux state, and their projections are exact eigenstates. The PSG's sixfold-rotation sign, fixed by the dodecagon flux, doubles all Majorana bands, and the mirrors exclude a chiral phase in any uniform field, so only a sublattice-staggered three-spin term drives the non-Abelian Ising phase. Beyond the Kitaev state, we find a critical semi-Dirac spin liquid, with mean-field correlations propto r⁻³ along three directions and r⁻⁶ otherwise, and extended Dirac phases with up to 48 fermion flavors, among them an N_f=12 state whose PSG forbids every singlet mass. Out-of-plane Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya couplings gap the Dirac states of its U(1) class into a mean-field spinon counterpart of the Kane-Mele quantum spin Hall insulator, with spin Chern number 1 or 3 and spin-carrying monopoles. Chiral states imply Kalmeyer-Laughlin, semion×semion, and three-fermion orders, rotation-breaking ones show q→ -q asymmetric neutron spectra, and sign-alternating fluxes break time reversal alone. Masses and monopoles in these many-flavor phases and the energetics of frustrated SHD Heisenberg models are natural next steps.
full_list.abstract_zh: 方形六边形十二边形（SHD）晶格拥有完全可解的基塔耶夫自旋液体，而更邻近的耦合将其海森堡磁体抑制成经典简并线，其中量子涨落可以熔化尼尔级。为了将该状态置于晶格的自旋液体中，我们根据射影对称群（PSG）对具有单重态和自旋轨道耦合三重态振幅的费米子部分子平均场态进行分类。由于SHD位点缺乏位点对称性，其Z2 PSG是具有时间反转的p6mm的投影类，每个单轨道p6mm晶格的投影类都遵循该类。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 方形六边形十二边形（SHD）晶格拥有完全可解的基塔耶夫自旋液体，而更邻近的耦合将其海森堡磁体抑制成经典简并线，其中量子涨落可以熔化尼尔级。为了将该状态置于晶格的自旋液体中，我们根据射影对称群（PSG）对具有单重态和自旋轨道耦合三重态振幅的费米子部分子平均场态进行分类。由于SHD位点缺乏位点对称性，其Z2 PSG是具有时间反转的p6mm的投影类，每个单轨道p6mm晶格的投影类都遵循该类。在理想化的 Kitaev 模型中，晶格运算不会旋转自旋，这些液体携带从 SU(2) Lieb 通量态下降的单个 Z2 PSG，并且它们的投影是精确的本征态。 PSG 的六重旋转符号由十二边形通量固定，使所有马约拉纳能带加倍，并且镜子排除了任何均匀场中的手征相，因此只有亚晶格交错的三自旋项驱动非阿贝尔伊辛相。除了基塔耶夫态之外，我们还发现了一种临界的半狄拉克自旋液体，其平均场相关性沿三个方向为 r⁻3，否则为 r⁻⁶，并且具有多达 48 种费米子风味的扩展狄拉克相，其中 N_f=12 态的 PSG 禁止每个单重态质量。面外 Dzyaloshinskii-Moriya 耦合将其 U(1) 类的狄拉克态间隙为 Kane-Mele 量子自旋霍尔绝缘体的平均场自旋子对应物，具有自旋陈数 1 或 3 和自旋承载单极子。手性态意味着卡尔迈耶-劳克林、半子×半子和三费米子级，旋转破坏态显示 q→ -q 不对称中子谱，而符号交替通量仅破坏时间反转。这些多风味相中的质量和单极子以及受挫的 SHD 海森堡模型的能量学是自然的下一步。

full_list.title_en: Light-Induced Even-Parity Unidirectionally Polarized Spin Splitting in Coplanar Antiferromagnets
full_list.title_zh: 共面反铁磁体中的光致偶宇称单向偏振自旋分裂
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2601.03358v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: When a coplanar antiferromagnet (AFM) with xy-plane magnetic moments exhibits a spin-split band structure and unidirectional spin polarization along z, the spin polarization is forced to be an odd function of momentum by the fundamental symmetry [barC₂z|T]. Coplanar AFMs displaying such odd-parity, unidirectionally polarized spin splittings are known as odd-parity magnets. In this work, we propose the realization of their missing even-parity counterparts. We begin by deriving the symmetry conditions required for an even-parity, out-of-plane spin splitting. We then show that irradiating a spin-degenerate coplanar AFM with circularly polarized light lifts the [barC₂z|T] constraint, dynamically generating this even-parity state. Specifically, the light-induced unidirectionally polarized spin splitting exhibits a d-wave texture in momentum space, akin to that of a d-wave altermagnet. We prove this texture's robustness against spin canting and propose time-, spin- and angle-resolved photoemission photocurrent as a direct probe. Our work demonstrates that optical driving can generate novel spin-split phases in coplanar AFMs, thereby diversifying the landscape of materials exhibiting distinct spin splittings.
full_list.abstract_zh: 当具有 xy 平面磁矩的共面反铁磁体 (AFM) 表现出自旋分裂能带结构和沿 z 的单向自旋极化时，由于基本对称性 [barC2z|T]，自旋极化被迫成为动量的奇函数。显示这种奇宇称、单向极化自旋分裂的共面原子力显微镜被称为奇宇称磁体。在这项工作中，我们建议实现其缺失的偶校验对应物。我们首先推导偶宇称、面外自旋分裂所需的对称条件。然后我们证明，用圆偏振光照射自旋简并共面 AFM 会解除 [barC2z|T] 约束，动态生成这种偶宇称状态。
