full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《共面反铁磁体中的光致偶宇称单向偏振自旋分裂》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Light-induced local control of magnetic anisotropy and domain pattern in Co/Pt multilayers
full_list.title_zh: Co/Pt 多层膜中磁各向异性和磁畴图案的光致局部控制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23132v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Control of magnetic anisotropy is essential for the fabrication of next-generation devices in spintronics and magnetic memory. While conventional approaches such as material composition, thermal annealing, and ion bombardment are widely used, achieving spatially resolved, continuous control remains a challenge. Herein, we demonstrate a dual-regime, localized control over both transient magnetic states and permanent intrinsic properties in perpendicularly magnetized Co/Pt multilayers using ultra-short laser pulses. By employing a multi-scale approach combining Kerr microscopy, magnetic force microscopy, and vibrating sample magnetometry, we reveal that low-fluence irradiation enables a reversible, helicity-dependent accumulation of magnetic phases without altering the intrinsic quasistatic properties. Conversely, high-fluence exposure acts as localized thermal annealing that permanently hardens the magnetic system. This structural relaxation leads to a substantial enhancement of the effective perpendicular magnetic anisotropy, driving a twofold increase in the local coercive field and expanding the equilibrium stripe domain width. By offering both reversible spin manipulation and deterministic engineering of 2D magnetic landscapes, this work paves the way towards flexible, lithography-free anisotropy structuring for advanced spintronic applications.
full_list.abstract_zh: 磁各向异性的控制对于自旋电子学和磁存储器中下一代器件的制造至关重要。虽然材料成分、热退火和离子轰击等传统方法被广泛使用，但实现空间分辨、连续控制仍然是一个挑战。在此，我们展示了使用超短激光脉冲对垂直磁化 Co/Pt 多层膜中的瞬态磁态和永久本征特性进行双态局部控制。通过采用结合克尔显微镜、磁力显微镜和振动样品磁力测量的多尺度方法，我们揭示了低通量照射能够实现可逆的、螺旋性相关的磁相积累，而不会改变固有的准静态特性。相反，高通量暴露起到局部热退火的作用，使磁系统永久硬化。

full_list.title_en: Limits from nonlinear loss of spin-orbit-torque control of magnon transport
full_list.title_zh: 磁振子输运自旋轨道扭矩控制非线性损失的限制
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23763v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Controlling magnon currents is central to the development of magnonic devices, which exploit spin excitations for information transport without charge flow. Here, we use the spin-orbit torque (SOT) from a Pt gate to control the effective magnon damping in three-terminal devices fabricated from low-damping lithium aluminum ferrite (LAFO) thin films and identify the nonlinear damping that ultimately limits the gate response. With increasing gate current, the nonlocal magnon signal initially increases, but saturates and subsequently decreases above a critical gate current density. Brillouin light scattering microscopy reveals that this turnover coincides with the emergence of an SOT-driven auto-oscillation mode localized beneath the gate, whose frequency continuously redshifts with increasing gate current, characteristic of large-amplitude nonlinear dynamics, and with a suppression of the propagating magnon population away from the gate. Micromagnetic simulations reproduce the observed nonmonotonic gate response only when an amplitude-dependent effective damping is included, indicating that nonlinear losses, rather than saturation of spin injection, limit the degree of magnon modulation. Our results show that SOT compensation of magnon damping is ultimately limited by nonlinear damping attributed to auto-oscillations, providing a framework for understanding the limits of magnon current modulation in magnetic insulators.
full_list.abstract_zh: 控制磁振子电流是磁振子器件开发的核心，磁振子器件利用自旋激励在没有电荷流的情况下进行信息传输。在这里，我们使用 Pt 栅极的自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 来控制由低阻尼锂铝铁氧体 (LAFO) 薄膜制成的三端器件中的有效磁振子阻尼，并确定最终限制栅极响应的非线性阻尼。随着栅极电流的增加，非局部磁振子信号最初增加，但饱和并随后减小到临界栅极电流密度以上。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 控制磁振子电流是磁振子器件开发的核心，磁振子器件利用自旋激励在没有电荷流的情况下进行信息传输。在这里，我们使用 Pt 栅极的自旋轨道扭矩 (SOT) 来控制由低阻尼锂铝铁氧体 (LAFO) 薄膜制成的三端器件中的有效磁振子阻尼，并确定最终限制栅极响应的非线性阻尼。随着栅极电流的增加，非局部磁振子信号最初增加，但饱和并随后减小到临界栅极电流密度以上。布里渊光散射显微镜揭示，这种转换与位于栅极下方的 SOT 驱动的自动振荡模式的出现相一致，其频率随着栅极电流的增加而连续红移，这是大振幅非线性动力学的特征，并且抑制传播的磁振子群体远离栅极。仅当包含与幅度相关的有效阻尼时，微磁模拟才能重现观察到的非单调栅极响应，这表明非线性损耗（而不是自旋注入的饱和度）限制了磁振子调制的程度。我们的结果表明，磁振子阻尼的 SOT 补偿最终受到自振荡引起的非线性阻尼的限制，这为理解磁绝缘体中磁振子电流调制的局限性提供了一个框架。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic Field-assisted Crystallographic Selection During Grain Growth in Non-Magnetic Polycrystals: A Phase-Field Study
full_list.title_zh: 非磁性多晶晶粒生长过程中的磁场辅助晶体选择：相场研究
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23473v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Magnetic fields drive grain boundary migration in non-magnetic systems through anisotropic susceptibility, yet how the local orientation can affect the resulting collective grain growth behavior remains unclear. We employ a phase-field model to investigate magnetic-field-assisted grain growth in the diamagnetic Bi. This study provides a mechanistic basis for using static and dynamically varied magnetic fields to control texture development and grain growth kinetics in weakly magnetic materials. We also identify the conditions under which magnetic-field-driven orientation selection produces a distinct bimodal grain-size distribution. The bicrystal studies establish that boundary migration is governed by the magnetic free-energy difference between differently oriented grains, while polycrystalline field-sweep simulations reveal a transition from capillary-dominated coarsening to magnetically biased texture selection. For unbiased orientation distributions, magnetic selection remains distributed; however, when a small population of grains is strongly favored, the driving force localizes and exhibits bimodal coarsening characterized by enlarged favored grains embedded within a fine-grained matrix, even without grain boundary energy anisotropy, particle pinning, or heterogeneity. full_list.abstract_zh: 磁场通过各向异性磁化率驱动非磁性系统中的晶界迁移，但局部取向如何影响由此产生的集体晶粒生长行为仍不清楚。我们采用相场模型来研究抗磁性 Bi 中磁场辅助的晶粒生长。这项研究为使用静态和动态变化的磁场来控制弱磁性材料中的织构发展和晶粒生长动力学提供了机械基础。我们还确定了磁场驱动的取向选择产生独特的双峰晶粒尺寸分布的条件。双晶研究表明，边界迁移受不同取向晶粒之间的磁自由能差异控制，而多晶场扫描模拟揭示了从毛细管主导的粗化到磁偏置织构选择的转变。对于无偏方向分布，磁选择保持分布；

full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《非磁性多晶晶粒生长过程中的磁场辅助晶体选择：相场研究》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic order in epitaxial (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 trilayer heterostructures: Evidence for quasi-two-dimensional ferrimagnetism
full_list.title_zh: 外延 (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 三层异质结构中的磁序：准二维亚铁磁性的证据
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23556v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The realization of artificial magnetic structures with high epitaxial quality and elevated critical temperatures remains a key challenge for spintronics. Here, we report the fabrication and characterization of epitaxial (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 trilayer heterostructures grown by layer-by-layer laser ablation. High-resolution transmission electron microscopy, magnetization measurements, and neutron diffraction confirm their exceptional crystalline order and the absence of structural defects. Neutron diffraction reveals no antiferromagnetic Bragg peaks, ruling out most antiferromagnetic configurations with a non zero wave vector Q. Magnetic hysteresis loops instead evidence a ferromagnetic order with a remanent moment of about 0.5 bohr magneton per Mn atom at room temperature, persisting either in-plane or out-of-plane depending on the applied field. Our findings highlight neutron diffraction as a powerful tool for elucidating the magnetic structure of complex thin films and suggest that weak interlayer coupling through BaTiO3 leads to ferromagnetism with a high critical temperature (about 600 K).
full_list.abstract_zh: 实现具有高外延质量和升高临界温度的人造磁结构仍然是自旋电子学的一个关键挑战。在这里，我们报告了通过逐层激光烧蚀生长的外延 (La2/3Sr1/3MnO3)3/(BaTiO3)3 三层异质结构的制造和表征。高分辨率透射电子显微镜、磁化测量和中子衍射证实了它们特殊的晶体顺序并且不存在结构缺陷。中子衍射显示没有反铁磁布拉格峰，排除了大多数具有非零波矢量 Q 的反铁磁构型。

full_list.title_en: Magnetic tunnel junctions of twisted La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 freestanding bilayers
full_list.title_zh: 扭曲的 La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 独立双层的磁性隧道结
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23720v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Transition metal oxides (TMOs) host a variety of emergent spintronic or multiferroic functionalities owing to the intricate interplay between lattice, orbital, charge, and spin degrees of freedom. Recent advances in epitaxial lift-off and dry transfer techniques using water-soluble sacrificial layers enables stacking and twisting of freestanding membranes of such strongly correlated oxides, providing even richer physical properties and functionalities. To date, the twisted junctions of TMOs have been mainly investigated in insulators, focusing on their structural and dielectric properties. Here, we demonstrate that the twisted bilayer membranes of La2/3Sr1/3MnO3, a prototypical half-metallic ferromagnetic metal TMO, offer a magnetic tunnel junction (MTJ) with their van der Waals (vdW) gap acting as a tunnel barrier. The twisted junctions of La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 exhibit tunnelling magnetoresistance (TMR) effect with respect to relative orientation of magnetizations of top and bottom membranes. In addition, high-field magnetoresistance shows uniaxial anisotropy, which can be assigned to tunnelling anisotropic magnetoresistance (TAMR) effect reflecting rhombohedral distortion of fully-relaxed La2/3Sr1/3MnO3. The demonstration of TMR and TAMR effects suggests that spin and in-plane momentum degrees of freedom of 3d electrons are conserved across the twisted junctions of TMOs, opening a new avenue for realizing strongly correlated twistronics utilizing electron coherence through tunnelling processes.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由于晶格、轨道、电荷和自旋自由度之间复杂的相互作用，过渡金属氧化物（TMO）具有各种新兴的自旋电子或多铁功能。使用水溶性牺牲层的外延剥离和干转移技术的最新进展使得这种强相关氧化物的独立膜能够堆叠和扭曲，从而提供更丰富的物理性质和功能。迄今为止，TMO 的扭曲结主要在绝缘体中进行研究，重点关注其结构和介电性能。在这里，我们证明了 La2/3Sr1/3MnO3（一种典型的半金属铁磁金属 TMO）的扭曲双层膜提供了磁性隧道结（MTJ），其范德华（vdW）间隙充当隧道势垒。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 由于晶格、轨道、电荷和自旋自由度之间复杂的相互作用，过渡金属氧化物（TMO）具有各种新兴的自旋电子或多铁功能。使用水溶性牺牲层的外延剥离和干转移技术的最新进展使得这种强相关氧化物的独立膜能够堆叠和扭曲，从而提供更丰富的物理性质和功能。迄今为止，TMO 的扭曲结主要在绝缘体中进行研究，重点关注其结构和介电性能。在这里，我们证明了 La2/3Sr1/3MnO3（一种典型的半金属铁磁金属 TMO）的扭曲双层膜提供了磁性隧道结（MTJ），其范德华（vdW）间隙充当隧道势垒。 La2/3Sr1/3MnO3 的扭曲结表现出相对于顶部和底部膜磁化强度的相对方向的隧道磁阻（TMR）效应。此外，高场磁阻表现出单轴各向异性，这可以归因于反映完全松弛的La2/3Sr1/3MnO3的菱面体畸变的隧道各向异性磁阻（TAMR）效应。 TMR和TAMR效应的演示表明，3d电子的自旋和面内动量自由度在TMO扭转结上是守恒的，这为通过隧道过程利用电子相干性实现强相关扭转电子学开辟了新途径。

full_list.title_en: Non-Adiabatic Spin-Induced Currents in Magnetic Weyl Semimetals
full_list.title_zh: 磁性韦尔半金属中的非绝热自旋感应电流
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23197v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We theoretically study dc electric currents induced by rapid spin precession in noncentrosymmetric magnetic Weyl semimetals using the Floquet--Keldysh Green's-function formalism. The spin dynamics act as a time-dependent chiral gauge field and the geometric structure of electric currents is expressed in terms of the Berry curvature, the quantum metric, and the shift vector. For an isotropic Weyl cone, only an injection current is generated. This current scales quadratically with the driving frequency and linearly with the relaxation time associated with coupling to a fermionic bath. We further show that a finite Weyl-cone tilt modifies the available interband-transition phase space, smooths the frequency dependence of the current, and allows for a shift current and another type of injection current, both of which flow in directions determined by the tilt and the direction of the precession. A finite net current can remain after summing contributions from Weyl nodes of opposite chiralities when their transition phase spaces are inequivalent.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们使用 Floquet--Keldysh Green 函数形式从理论上研究了非中心对称磁性 Weyl 半金属中快速自旋进动引起的直流电流。自旋动力学充当与时间相关的手性规范场，电流的几何结构用贝里曲率、量子度量和位移矢量表示。对于各向同性韦尔锥，仅产生注入电流。该电流与驱动频率成二次方关系，并与与费米子浴耦合相关的弛豫时间成线性关系。

full_list.title_en: Nonergodicity from Hilbert-Subspace Cloning
full_list.title_zh: 希尔伯特子空间克隆的非遍历性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23105v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We identify a class of nonintegrable quantum many-body systems composed of single Pauli strings that possess an extensive number of noncommuting local conserved quantities and exhibit partial ergodicity breaking due to exponentially degenerate energy spectra. We show that such systems exhibit a novel mechanism, Hilbert-subspace cloning, where the identical chaotic Hamiltonian acts on each of exponentially many disconnected Hilbert subspaces. Although the dynamics within each clone thermalizes, quantum coherence between clones remains protected and detectable by local observables. Consequently, the long-time behavior of local observables is described by a coherence-preserving partial Gibbs ensemble, where the hidden subsystem retains its initial quantum coherence.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们确定了一类由单个泡利弦组成的不可积量子多体系统，该系统拥有大量非交换局部守恒量，并由于指数简并能谱而表现出部分遍历性破坏。我们证明，此类系统表现出一种新颖的机制，即希尔伯特子空间克隆，其中相同的混沌哈密顿量作用于指数级多个不连通的希尔伯特子空间中的每一个。尽管每个克隆内的动力学都会热化，但克隆之间的量子相干性仍然受到保护，并且可以通过局部可观测值检测到。因此，局部可观测量的长期行为由保持相干性的部分吉布斯系综来描述，其中隐藏子系统保留其初始量子相干性。

full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：声子、有限温度和输运性质。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。

full_list.title_en: On the stability and emittance growth of different particle phase-space distributions in a long magnetic quadrupole channel
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：On the stability and emittance growth of different particle phase-space distributions in a long magnetic quadrupole channel
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2401.12595v3 Announce Type: replace Abstract: The behavior of K-V, waterbag, parabolic, conical and Gaussian distributions in periodic quadrupole channels is studied by particle simulations. In the parameter range studied, the response associated with the K-V instabilities becomes progressively less pronounced toward the Gaussian distribution. For the third-order instability studied here, the emittance growth factor of an initially Gaussian beam after a large number of periods is considerably lower than that of an equivalent K-V distribution.newlineindent In addition, the non-K-V distributions exhibit a rapid initial emittance growth within approximately one period of the channel, which becomes very significant at high beam intensities. This growth is attributed to the homogenization of the space-charge density, resulting in a conversion of electric-field energy into transverse kinetic and potential energy. Two simple analytical formulae based on different energy-partition assumptions are derived as estimates for this effect and are compared with the results obtained from particle simulations. They are not rigorous lower and upper bounds for arbitrary beam evolution. [6pt] Original publication in Particle Accelerators bf 15, 47--65 (1984)}

full_list.title_en: Pressure-Dependent hcp-to-fcc Phase Transition Path Derived from Exact Lattice Summations over Inverse Power Law Potentials
full_list.title_zh: 由逆幂律势的精确晶格求和得出的压力相关的 hcp 到 FCC 相变路径
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.22855v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We investigate the phase transition between hexagonal close-packed (hcp) and face-centered cubic (fcc) structures along the Burgers-Bain transformation path at pressures up to several hundred gigapascals. We consider a hierarchy of interatomic potentials, from (n,m)-Lennard-Jones potentials to extended Lennard-Jones two-body interactions in terms of inverse-power expansions and the Axilrod-Teller-Muto three-body term, alongside density functional theory (DFT) calculations for solid argon. For inverse-power potentials, free energies are evaluated through exact lattice sums and efficient integral representations based on generalizations of the Epstein zeta function to anisotropic interaction kernels, followed by lattice-parameter optimization. This methodology enables an accurate determination of the pressure-dependent Burgers-Bain minimum-energy path and the associated activation barrier for the phase transition. The transformation exhibits pronounced symmetry breaking connecting the Burgers and Bain paths, a feature confirmed by DFT calculations. At high pressure, the hcp-to-fcc activation barrier increases approximately linearly with pressure, owing to the dominant pressure-volume contribution. Including entropy and anharmonic effects yields excellent agreement with experimental temperature-dependent volumes up to the melting point. DFT results also highlight the increasing importance of many-body interactions under compression. Whereas two-body potentials predict that the path passes through the body-centered cubic (bcc) structure only at very high pressures, DFT generally predicts a pathway that bypasses bcc. The Axilrod-Teller-Muto term slightly reduces this discrepancy. Furthermore, DFT performs better at high pressures, where dispersion forces become less important.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们研究了在高达数百吉帕的压力下，六方密堆积 (hcp) 和面心立方 (fcc) 结构之间沿着伯格斯-贝恩变换路径的相变。我们考虑了原子间势的层次结构，从 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势到以逆幂展开和 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 三体项形式扩展的 Lennard-Jones 二体相互作用，以及固体氩的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们研究了在高达数百吉帕的压力下，六方密堆积 (hcp) 和面心立方 (fcc) 结构之间沿着伯格斯-贝恩变换路径的相变。我们考虑了原子间势的层次结构，从 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势到以逆幂展开和 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 三体项形式扩展的 Lennard-Jones 二体相互作用，以及固体氩的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。对于反幂势，通过精确的晶格和和基于 Epstein zeta 函数到各向异性相互作用核的有效积分表示来评估自由能，然后进行晶格参数优化。该方法能够准确确定压力相关的 Burgers-Bain 最小能量路径和相关的相变激活势垒。该变换表现出连接 Burgers 和 Bain 路径的明显对称性破缺，这一特征已被 DFT 计算证实。在高压下，由于主要的压力-体积贡献，hcp-to-FCC 活化势垒随压力近似线性增加。包括熵和非谐波效应，与直到熔点的实验温度相关体积都非常一致。 DFT 结果还强调了压缩下多体相互作用的重要性。二体势预测路径仅在非常高的压力下穿过体心立方 (bcc) 结构，而 DFT 通常预测绕过 bcc 的路径。 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 项稍微缩小了这种差异。此外，DFT 在高压下表现更好，此时色散力变得不那么重要。
full_list.summary: 我们研究了在高达数百吉帕的压力下，六方密堆积 (hcp) 和面心立方 (fcc) 结构之间沿着伯格斯-贝恩变换路径的相变。我们考虑了原子间势的层次结构，从 (n,m)-Lennard-Jones 势到以逆幂展开和 Axilrod-Teller-Muto 三体项形式扩展的 Lennard-Jones 二体相互作用，以及固体氩的密度泛函理论 (DFT) 计算。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开。从摘要能确认的线索包括：密度泛函理论和电子结构计算，以及AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的热力学知情 ML、机器学习势、自由能采样、CALPHAD/团簇展开嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂ 基铁电、二维滑移铁电、钙钛矿和磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“在 DFT 能量/力/应力之外加入跨温度构型、相对自由能、熵或热膨胀信息；用主动学习补采相变、畴壁和相竞争区域，再用热力学积分、MC 或有限温度 MD 验证”补充训练/验证集，再比较《由逆幂律势的精确晶格求和得出的压力相关的 hcp 到 FCC 相变路径》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Symmetry constraints on magnon-induced dynamics of skyrmion helicity in frustrated magnets
full_list.title_zh: 受挫磁体中斯格明子螺旋磁振子诱导动力学的对称约束
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23699v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The helicity of a magnetic skyrmion in a centrosymmetric frustrated magnet is a soft collective coordinate and a candidate variable for encoding quantum information. Its coherence is ultimately influenced by coupling to the magnon environment, which is commonly incorporated only phenomenologically. Here we combine a microscopic Keldysh treatment of the helicity--magnon coupling to resolve the contribution of individual magnon modes to the effective helicity dynamics. In the U(1)-symmetric model, the magnon bath generates, to leading order, a reactive helicity mass renormalization. When U(1) symmetry is broken, additional direct helicity--magnon couplings become allowed. In the presence of finite magnon lifetimes, these couplings generate an Ohmic contribution to the low-frequency helicity dynamics. The spatial symmetry of the perturbation determines which magnon sectors contribute to this damping, providing mode-resolved selection rules for the helicity--magnon coupling. Thus, we establish a microscopic connection between helicity dynamics and the excitation spectrum of frustrated skyrmions and identify the symmetry constraints governing dissipation of helicity-based quantum states.
full_list.abstract_zh: 中心对称受挫磁体中磁性斯格明子的螺旋度是软集体坐标和用于编码量子信息的候选变量。它的相干性最终受到与磁振子环境耦合的影响，磁振子环境通常仅在现象学上被纳入。在这里，我们结合了螺旋度-磁振子耦合的微观 Keldysh 处理来解决单个磁振子模式对有效螺旋度动力学的贡献。在 U(1) 对称模型中，磁振子浴产生主序的反应螺旋质量重正化。当 U(1) 对称性被破坏时，允许额外的直接螺旋性磁振子耦合。在存在有限磁振子寿命的情况下，这些耦合会对低频螺旋动力学产生欧姆贡献。

full_list.title_en: Temperature and Thickness Dependent Spin Current Transmission through Epitaxial Antiferromagnetic α-Fe2O3
full_list.title_zh: 通过外延反铁磁 α-Fe2O3 进行温度和厚度相关的自旋电流传输
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23764v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Antiferromagnetic insulator α-Fe2O3 is a potential medium for coherent motion of spin waves over relatively large distances, allowing non-dissipative transfer of information between circuit elements. However, the structural defects and temperature dependent spin reorientations in this oxide impact the propagation. Understanding how the magnetic state of an antiferromagnetic insulator affects spin-current transmission is therefore important for elucidating the mechanisms governing spin transport. Here, we report spin-current transmission through epitaxial α-Fe2O3 thin films sandwiched between Permalloy and Pt. Using spin pumping and inverse spin Hall effect, we observe a finite symmetric dc voltage across the Pt layer over the temperature range 1.6 to 300 K for alpha-Fe2O3 thicknesses of 0, 30, 40, and 100 nm. The symmetric voltage coefficient Ks exhibits two approximately linear temperature regimes, separated by a characteristic temperature T* whose value depends on the thickness of the α-Fe2O3 layer. Further, the dc magnetization measurements on some of the samples suggest that the T* is correlated with the spin reorientation transition (Morin transition) in α-Fe2O3. Interestingly, a significantly larger magnitude of dKs/dT is noted below the characteristic temperature T*. The observed thickness and temperature dependent spin-current transmission indicates a sensitivity to the magnetic state of the insulating hematite layer.
full_list.abstract_zh: 反铁磁绝缘体 α-Fe2O3 是一种潜在的介质，可在相对较大的距离内实现自旋波的相干运动，从而允许电路元件之间进行非耗散的信息传输。然而，这种氧化物中的结构缺陷和温度相关的自旋重新取向会影响传播。因此，了解反铁磁绝缘体的磁性状态如何影响自旋电流传输对于阐明控制自旋传输的机制非常重要。在这里，我们报告了通过夹在坡莫合金和铂之间的外延 α-Fe2O3 薄膜的自旋电流传输。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 反铁磁绝缘体 α-Fe2O3 是一种潜在的介质，可在相对较大的距离内实现自旋波的相干运动，从而允许电路元件之间进行非耗散的信息传输。然而，这种氧化物中的结构缺陷和温度相关的自旋重新取向会影响传播。因此，了解反铁磁绝缘体的磁性状态如何影响自旋电流传输对于阐明控制自旋传输的机制非常重要。在这里，我们报告了通过夹在坡莫合金和铂之间的外延 α-Fe2O3 薄膜的自旋电流传输。利用自旋泵浦和逆自旋霍尔效应，我们观察到厚度为 0、30、40 和 100 nm 的 α-Fe2O3 在 1.6 至 300 K 的温度范围内穿过 Pt 层的有限对称直流电压。对称电压系数 Ks 表现出两个近似线性的温度范围，由特征温度 T* 分开，其值取决于 α-Fe2O3 层的厚度。此外，一些样品的直流磁化强度测量表明 T* 与 α-Fe2O3 中的自旋重定向转变（莫林转变）相关。有趣的是，在特征温度 T* 以下，dKs/dT 的幅度明显更大。观察到的厚度和温度相关的自旋电流传输表明对绝缘赤铁矿层的磁性状态的敏感性。

full_list.title_en: Topological Magnetism in 2D and 3D: Skyrmions and Hopfions. Classical and quantum approaches
full_list.title_zh: 2D 和 3D 拓扑磁学：斯格明子和霍普菲子。经典和量子方法
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23490v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: We discuss the properties of ferromagnetic skyrmions in relation to the Dzyaloshinskii Moriya interaction, nonlinear sigma models, merons, vortices, frustration, and dipole dipole interactions. Particular attention is given to skyrmion skyrmion interactions and to the dynamical equations governing magnetic textures, including the Landau Lifshitz Gilbert, Thiele, and Landau Lifshitz Bloch equations. The review subsequently extends the discussion to antiferromagnetic systems and to topological structures in three dimensions, with emphasis on Hopfions and their topological characterization. We then examine quantum skyrmions, including approaches that go beyond the semiclassical description, and discuss the emergence of quantum Hopfions. The theoretical framework is complemented by appendices presenting analytical solutions and ansatzes for skyrmions, spin coherent states and path integrals, quantum antiferromagnets, spin torques, fiber-bundle concepts and the Hopf map, and the Euler Lagrange formalism in three dimensions. By connecting continuum field theory, magnetic dynamics, topology, and quantum mechanics, this review aims to provide a coherent framework for understanding the formation, stability, dynamics, interactions, and quantum properties of topological magnetic textures across different dimensions and magnetic systems.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们讨论了与 Dzyaloshinskii Moriya 相互作用、非线性 sigma 模型、Meron、涡旋、挫败和偶极偶极相互作用相关的铁磁斯格明子的特性。特别关注斯格明子斯格明子相互作用和控制磁性纹理的动力学方程，包括兰道·利夫希茨·吉尔伯特、蒂勒和兰道·利夫希茨·布洛赫方程。该综述随后将讨论扩展到反铁磁系统和三维拓扑结构，重点是 Hopfions 及其拓扑表征。然后，我们研究量子斯格明子，包括超越半经典描述的方法，并讨论量子霍普菲子的出现。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们讨论了与 Dzyaloshinskii Moriya 相互作用、非线性 sigma 模型、Meron、涡旋、挫败和偶极偶极相互作用相关的铁磁斯格明子的特性。特别关注斯格明子斯格明子相互作用和控制磁性纹理的动力学方程，包括兰道·利夫希茨·吉尔伯特、蒂勒和兰道·利夫希茨·布洛赫方程。该综述随后将讨论扩展到反铁磁系统和三维拓扑结构，重点是 Hopfions 及其拓扑表征。然后，我们研究量子斯格明子，包括超越半经典描述的方法，并讨论量子霍普菲子的出现。理论框架由附录提供解析解和模拟，包括斯格明子、自旋相干态和路径积分、量子反铁磁体、自旋扭矩、纤维束概念和 Hopf 图，以及三维欧拉拉格朗日形式主义。通过连接连续介质场理论、磁动力学、拓扑和量子力学，这篇综述旨在提供一个连贯的框架，用于理解不同维度和磁系统的拓扑磁纹理的形成、稳定性、动力学、相互作用和量子特性。
full_list.summary: 我们讨论了与 Dzyaloshinskii Moriya 相互作用、非线性 sigma 模型、Meron、涡旋、挫败和偶极偶极相互作用相关的铁磁斯格明子的特性。特别关注斯格明子斯格明子相互作用和控制磁性纹理的动力学方程，包括兰道·利夫希茨·吉尔伯特、蒂勒和兰道·利夫希茨·布洛赫方程。该综述随后将讨论扩展到反铁磁系统和三维拓扑结构，重点是 Hopfions 及其拓扑表征。然后，我们研究量子斯格明子，包括超越半经典描述的方法，并讨论量子霍普菲子的出现。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《2D 和 3D 拓扑磁学：斯格明子和霍普菲子。经典和量子方法》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: Landau theory and exchange instabilities in Mn₅Si₃: A case against strain-induced altermagnetism
full_list.title_zh: Mn · Si · Landau理论与交换不稳定性：一个反对应变诱导反磁性的案例
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.13483v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Thin-film Mn₅Si₃ is a prominent altermagnetic candidate owing to its metallicity, demonstrated anisotropic anomalous transport, and proposed d-wave exchange splitting that could enable spin-polarized transport. Its postulated altermagnetic structure has zero propagation vector, unlike the bulk collinear antiferromagnetic AFM2 phase, which orders at the M star. We analyze both phases using Landau theory, first-principles paramagnetic-instability calculations, and Monte Carlo simulations. AFM2 appears in Landau theory as a symmetry-protected inversion-even, permutation-odd mode at a single arm of the M star. At Γ, the same intracell pattern belongs to the collinear sector of an E₂g order parameter; both phases require higher-order terms for their selection. Disordered-local-moment calculations identify the leading exchange instability at M, and the resulting classical Heisenberg model orders at the bulk experimental temperature scale into the orthogonal 3M phase favored by single-site entropy. Magnetostructural coupling to E₂g deformations favors single-M AFM2 ordering. The estimated homogeneous-strain contribution to the relevant quartic coefficient is about a quarter of the competing entropic term near the bulk transition, while internal E₂g relaxations are expected to provide additional stabilization. The Γ-point E₂g mode, whose Landau theory contains the altermagnetic sector, is substantially weaker and further suppressed by epitaxial strain comparable to that reported for Mn₅Si₃/Si(111) films exhibiting anomalous transport. The same strain reduces the leading magnetic exchange scale. These results explain the bulk M-point instability but strongly disfavor relocating the propagation vector from M to Γ in a moderately strained bulklike Mn₅Si₃ film, leaving the identity of the Hall-active phase unresolved.
full_list.abstract_zh: 由于其金属性，薄膜Mn * Si *是一种突出的替代磁性候选物，证明了各向异性异常传输，并提出了可以实现自旋极化传输的d波交换分裂。其假设的变磁结构具有零传播矢量，不像在M星处有序的本体共线反铁磁AFM2相。我们使用Landau理论、第一原理顺磁不稳定性计算和蒙特卡罗模拟来分析这两个阶段。在Landau理论中， AFM2在M星的单臂上作为对称保护的反转（甚至是置换）模式出现。在Γ处，相同的胞内模式属于E ₂ g阶参数的共线扇区；这两个阶段都需要更高阶的项来选择它们。

full_list.title_en: Negative thermal expansion, lattice dynamics, and complex magnetism in TbFeO₃
full_list.title_zh: TbFeO中的负热膨胀、晶格动力学和复合磁性
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2608.00469v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: We report a temperature-dependent investigation of orthoferrite TbFeO₃ using x-ray diffraction, DC magnetization, and Raman scattering, complemented by room-temperature x-ray photoelectron spectroscopy. X-ray diffraction reveals negative thermal expansion over 5-300 K, with a small but systematic increase in unit-cell volume upon cooling in the absence of any structural phase transition. Raman scattering measurements identify the Raman-active phonon modes and show clear deviations from the conventional Klemens anharmonic decay model, particularly in phonon frequencies, indicating the presence of spin-phonon coupling. Two modes of A_g and B₁g symmetry exhibit a crossover from Gaussian-dominated line shapes at low temperatures to mixed Gaussian-Lorentzian profiles at higher temperatures, reflecting a transition from inhomogeneous broadening to lifetime-driven dynamics. High-energy Raman spectra reveal two-magnon excitations associated with the Fe sublattice, consistent with linear spin-wave theory, whose spectral weight shows only weak temperature dependence. In addition, a broad Raman mode emerging below sim 175 K exhibits an order-parameter-like temperature evolution and coincides with the onset of phonon anomalies, while no corresponding strong anomaly is observed in the two-magnon response. Taken together, these results establish TbFeO₃ as a system with pronounced interplay among lattice dynamics, spin correlations, and emergent local magnetic-lattice anomalies.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们报告了使用x射线衍射、直流磁化和拉曼散射对正铁氧体TbFeO ”进行的温度依赖性研究，并辅以室温x射线光电子能谱。X射线衍射显示5-300 K以上的负热膨胀，在没有任何结构相变的情况下，冷却后单位电池体积略有但系统性的增加。拉曼散射测量识别拉曼激活声子模式，并显示出与传统克莱门斯非谐衰减模型的明显偏差，特别是在声子频率方面，表明存在自旋-声子耦合。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们报告了使用x射线衍射、直流磁化和拉曼散射对正铁氧体TbFeO ”进行的温度依赖性研究，并辅以室温x射线光电子能谱。X射线衍射显示5-300 K以上的负热膨胀，在没有任何结构相变的情况下，冷却后单位电池体积略有但系统性的增加。拉曼散射测量识别拉曼激活声子模式，并显示出与传统克莱门斯非谐衰减模型的明显偏差，特别是在声子频率方面，表明存在自旋-声子耦合。两种模式的A_g和B_g对称表现出从低温下高斯主导的线形到高温下混合高斯-洛伦兹剖面的交叉，反映了从非均匀展宽到寿命驱动动力学的转变。高能拉曼光谱揭示了与Fe亚晶格相关的双磁子激发，这与线性自旋波理论一致，其光谱权重仅显示出微弱的温度依赖性。此外，在sim 175 K下方出现的宽拉曼模式表现出类似于有序参数的温度演变，并且与声子异常的发生一致，而在双磁子响应中未观察到相应的强异常。综上所述，这些结果确立了TbFeO作为一个在晶格动力学、自旋相关性和出现的局部磁晶格异常之间具有显着相互作用的系统。

full_list.title_en: Spectral theory of energy-selective quantum search with Ising Hamiltonian phase oracles
full_list.title_zh: 伊辛哈密顿相位预言的能量选择性量子搜索谱理论
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2606.03380v3 Announce Type: replace-cross Abstract: We develop an exact spectral-response theory for the Grover-type iterate (W_T=D_ξexp(-i T H)), in which the evolution generated by a diagonal Ising Hamiltonian is used directly as a continuous phase oracle. An energy-grouped recurrence and its generating-function solution show how the empirical characteristic function determines the position, width, height, and saturation time of an energy-selective resonance. For an annealed Gaussian density of states, a high-density-tail resonance containing (M) configurations is reached after (Θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) oracle calls with success probability (Θ(1)), giving a quadratic query improvement over independent uniform sampling with classical energy evaluation. For correlated random Ising spectra, overlap-dependent covariances lead to a realization-dependent resonance shift with root-mean-square scale (O(n⁻³)), parametrically larger than the resonance width, and can also reduce the peak height. The shift is both an algorithmic detuning and a coherent probe of sample-specific spectral fluctuations whose ensemble statistics reflect the Ising overlap structure. Spectral symmetrization and iterative calibration can remove or compensate the resonance-center displacement for prescribed-energy targeting. We also clarify the relation to designed spectral filters and the precision and coherence requirements of this asymptotic primitive.
full_list.abstract_zh: 我们为 Grover 型迭代开发了精确的谱响应理论 (W_T=D_xiexp(-i T H))，其中对角伊辛哈密顿量生成的演化被直接用作连续相预言。能量分组递归及其生成函数解显示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火的高斯态密度，在 (θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) 预言机调用后以成功概率 (θ(1)) 达到包含 (M) 配置的高密度尾部共振，与经典能量评估的独立均匀采样相比，二次查询得到了改进。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 我们为 Grover 型迭代开发了精确的谱响应理论 (W_T=D_xiexp(-i T H))，其中对角伊辛哈密顿量生成的演化被直接用作连续相预言。能量分组递归及其生成函数解显示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火的高斯态密度，在 (θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) 预言机调用后以成功概率 (θ(1)) 达到包含 (M) 配置的高密度尾部共振，与经典能量评估的独立均匀采样相比，二次查询得到了改进。对于相关随机伊辛光谱，重叠相关的协方差会导致均方根尺度 (O(n⁻3)) 的实现相关共振位移，其参数大于共振宽度，并且还可以降低峰高。这种偏移既是算法失谐，也是样本特定光谱波动的相干探测，其集合统计数据反映了伊辛重叠结构。光谱对称化和迭代校准可以消除或补偿规定能量瞄准的共振中心位移。我们还阐明了与设计的光谱滤波器的关系以及该渐近原语的精度和相干性要求。
full_list.summary: 我们为 Grover 型迭代开发了精确的谱响应理论 (W_T=D_xiexp(-i T H))，其中对角伊辛哈密顿量生成的演化被直接用作连续相预言。能量分组递归及其生成函数解显示了经验特征函数如何确定能量选择共振的位置、宽度、高度和饱和时间。对于退火的高斯态密度，在 (θ(sqrt2ⁿ/M)) 预言机调用后以成功概率 (θ(1)) 达到包含 (M) 配置的高密度尾部共振，与经典能量评估的独立均匀采样相比，二次查询得到了改进。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对《伊辛哈密顿相位预言的能量选择性量子搜索谱理论》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.title_en: ZStar: A unified toolkit for polarization, Born effective charges, dielectric and piezoelectric responses, and infrared and Raman spectra
full_list.title_zh: ZStar ：用于极化、天生有效电荷、介电和压电响应以及红外和拉曼光谱的统一工具包
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2609.16802v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Born effective charge (BEC) tensors link atomic displacements to polarization, thereby connecting lattice vibrations with dielectric response and infrared activity. We present ZStar, an open-source Python toolkit that automates calculations of polarization, BEC, phonons, static and frequency-dependent dielectric response, and infrared and Raman spectra. ZStar supports bulk crystals, two-dimensional materials, one-dimensional structures, and molecules through an integrated workflow for input preparation, execution, and response analysis. Berry-phase polarization and real-space dipoles describe responses along periodic and open directions, respectively. Its unified, symmetry-adapted finite-displacement framework jointly determines BEC and zone-center force constants from the same calculations, improving computational efficiency while preserving numerical accuracy. Strain-response calculations further provide proper piezoelectric coefficients and their internal-relaxation contributions for bulk crystals. In the ABACUS+PYATB route, electronic Hamiltonian data are reused to obtain Raman response without additional self-consistent calculations. Native response implementations from VASP and CP2K are also integrated. Matched infrared/Raman benchmarks against the implemented separate workflows achieve speedups of up to 8.4. An accompanying agent skill provides an agent-friendly interface for workflow integration. ZStar therefore offers an efficient and automated route for exploring polarization, BEC, dielectric and piezoelectric responses, and vibrational spectra across different material dimensionalities.
full_list.abstract_zh: 天然有效电荷（ BEC ）张量将原子位移与极化联系起来，从而将晶格振动与介电响应和红外活动联系起来。我们推出了ZStar ，这是一个开源的Python工具包，可以自动计算极化、BEC、声子、静态和频率相关的介电响应，以及红外和拉曼光谱。ZStar通过用于输入准备、执行和响应分析的集成工作流程，支持块状晶体、二维材料、一维结构和分子。浆果相极化和实空间偶极子分别描述了沿周期方向和开放方向的响应。
full_list.abstract_zh_full: 天然有效电荷（ BEC ）张量将原子位移与极化联系起来，从而将晶格振动与介电响应和红外活动联系起来。我们推出了ZStar ，这是一个开源的Python工具包，可以自动计算极化、BEC、声子、静态和频率相关的介电响应，以及红外和拉曼光谱。ZStar通过用于输入准备、执行和响应分析的集成工作流程，支持块状晶体、二维材料、一维结构和分子。浆果相极化和实空间偶极子分别描述了沿周期方向和开放方向的响应。其统一的、适应对称的有限位移框架通过相同的计算共同确定BEC和区域中心力常数，在保持数值精度的同时提高了计算效率。应变响应计算进一步为本体晶体提供适当的压电系数及其内部松弛贡献。在算盘+ PYATB路线中，电子哈密顿数据被重复使用以获得拉曼响应，而无需额外的自洽计算。还集成了VASP和CP2K的原生响应实现。与实施的单独工作流程相匹配的红外/拉曼基准可实现高达8.4的加速。随附的客服代表技能为工作流程集成提供了方便客服代表的界面。因此， ZStar为探索不同材料尺寸的极化、BEC、介电和压电响应以及振动光谱提供了一条高效的自动化路线。
full_list.summary: 天然有效电荷（ BEC ）张量将原子位移与极化联系起来，从而将晶格振动与介电响应和红外活动联系起来。我们推出了ZStar ，这是一个开源的Python工具包，可以自动计算极化、BEC、声子、静态和频率相关的介电响应，以及红外和拉曼光谱。ZStar通过用于输入准备、执行和响应分析的集成工作流程，支持块状晶体、二维材料、一维结构和分子。浆果相极化和实空间偶极子分别描述了沿周期方向和开放方向的响应。
full_list.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：有效哈密顿量或机器学习哈密顿量，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
full_list.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
full_list.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《ZStar ：用于极化、天生有效电荷、介电和压电响应以及红外和拉曼光谱的统一工具包》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

full_list.abstract: Nature Physics, Published online: 19 October 2026; doi:10.1038/s41567-026-03379-0 Magnetic skyrmions are known to exhibit a Hall effect in the presence of an electric current. Now it is shown that liquid-crystal solitons also exhibit a Hall-like drift under shear flow.

full_list.title_en: Quantum simulation of ligand-like molecules through sample-based quantum diagonalization in density matrix embedding framework
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Quantum simulation of ligand-like molecules through sample-based quantum diagonalization in density matrix embedding framework
full_list.abstract: The accurate treatment of electron correlation in extended molecular systems remains computationally challenging using classical electronic structure methods. Hybrid quantum–classical algorithms offer a potential route to overcome these limitations; however, their practical deployment on existing quantum computers requires strategies that both reduce problem size and mitigate hardware noise. In this work, we investigate ground-state energy calculations of ligand-like molecules using Sample-based Quantum Diagonalization (SQD) within the Density Matrix Embedding Theory (DMET) framework, focusing on low-symmetry systems with diverse bonding motifs that exhibit subsystem-dependent variations in fragment–environment entanglement. These entanglement-based variations directly influence bath orbital construction, impurity sizes, and the structure of the embedded Hamiltonians, posing nontrivial challenges for both embedding and quantum sampling. By combining DMET fragmentation with SQD-based construction of reduced configuration spaces through quantum sampling and iterative configuration recovery, we perform quantum simulations on IBM’s Eagle R3 (ibm_sherbrooke) and IBM’s Heron R3 (ibm_boston) superconducting quantum hardware, thereby showing that the entanglement structure across embedding subsystems plays a central role in determining the efficiency and accuracy of the simulations. Despite these complexities, we show that the DMET-SQD framework yields ground-state energies in strong agreement with DMET-full configuration interaction benchmarks, achieving chemical accuracy (1 kcal/mol) across all systems studied. These results demonstrate that SQD-based quantum simulations can be robustly extended to low-symmetry, chemically realistic, industry relevant molecules and highlight the importance of entanglement-aware embedding strategies for scalable quantum electronic structure calculations.

full_list.title_en: Geometry-Dependent Electronic Coupling and Singlet Fission Pathways in Carotenoid Dimers
full_list.title_zh: 文献研究：Geometry-Dependent Electronic Coupling and Singlet Fission Pathways in Carotenoid Dimers
full_list.abstract: arXiv:2610.23562v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using the density matrix renormalization group method, we solve the Pariser--Parr--Pople model of π-electron systems to determine the character and energies of the low-lying eigenstates of a lycopene dimer comprising two 22-carbon-atom chains. To complement these calculations, we use the molecular-exciton, valence-bond model of polyene systems to derive selection rules governing interchain coupling, which provide a physical framework for interpreting the DMRG results. We find that dimer geometry strongly influences both the character and energetics of the low-lying eigenstates. In vertically stacked dimers, neither the bright-dimer state nor the triplet-pair states contain any interchain charge-transfer (CT) character. In contrast, in slip-stacked dimers, both the bright-dimer state and triplet-pair states do contain interchain CT character. We also find that increasing the interchain coupling preferentially stabilizes states with greater interchain character, leading to a reordering of the low-lying eigenstates. These results have direct implications for energetically possible singlet fission (SF) mechanisms in carotenoid aggregates. For vertically stacked dimers, the only energetically viable pathway identified here proceeds through intermediate intrachain triplet-pair states, whereas slip-stacked geometries allow an additional SF pathway mediated by interchain CT states. Our results establish a direct connection between carotenoid packing geometry, symmetry-controlled electronic coupling, and the energetically accessible pathways for SF.

core_items.title_en: Scalable long-range machine learning interatomic potentials with electrical response for atomistic material modeling
core_items.title_zh: 可扩展的远程机器学习原子间势与原子材料建模的电响应
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.23643v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Accurate atomistic simulations of materials under electric fields require long-range electrostatics and electrical-response modeling at length scales beyond the reach of conventional first-principles methods. Yet these capabilities remain difficult to reconcile with the scalability of machine-learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs). Strictly local models enable efficient spatial parallelization but neglect long-range interactions, whereas existing electrostatic extensions introduce global dependencies that hinder distributed computation. Here, we overcome this limitation by analytically separating the long-range electrostatic forces and Born effective charges (BECs) into a global electrostatics calculation and strictly local derivatives of learned latent charges. This formulation preserves the spatial decomposability of equivariant MLIPs while enabling distributed evaluation of energies, forces, stresses, and BECs across different boundary conditions. Implemented as DPA4C-LR on the textttnvalchemi platform, the framework scales to 5.2 million atoms on four GPUs at approximately twice the computational cost of its short-range backbone. Trained on energies and forces, DPA4C-LR accurately infers BECs and reproduces the field-dependent infrared spectra of water. We further demonstrate its capabilities by recovering the characteristic slim polarization hysteresis of relaxor cePb(Mg₁/₃Nb₂/₃)O3, which is obscured by finite-size effects in smaller simulations; predicting a room-temperature field-driven ionic conductivity of 6.8 ± 0.7~mS/cm in amorphous ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl₄.₁; and modeling interfacial thermal transport across Si/diamond interfaces with slab-corrected electrostatics. By combining long-range physics, electrical-response inference, and distributed computation, this framework extends predictive atomistic modeling toward device-relevant length scales.
core_items.abstract_zh: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 在电场下对材料进行精确的原子模拟需要在长度尺度上进行长程静电和电响应建模，这超出了传统第一原理方法的范围。然而，这些功能仍然难以与机器学习原子间势（MLIP）的可扩展性相协调。严格的局部模型可以实现高效的空间并行化，但忽略了远程交互，而现有的静电扩展引入了阻碍分布式计算的全局依赖性。在这里，我们通过分析将长程静电力和玻恩有效电荷（BEC）分离为全局静电计算和学习潜电荷的严格局部导数来克服这一限制。该公式保留了等变 MLIP 的空间可分解性，同时能够跨不同边界条件对能量、力、应力和 BEC 进行分布式评估。该框架在 textttnvalchemi 平台上以 DPA4C-LR 的形式实现，可在四个 GPU 上扩展到 520 万个原子，计算成本约为其短程主干的两倍。经过能量和力的训练，DPA4C-LR 可以准确推断 BEC 并再现水的场相关红外光谱。我们通过恢复弛豫剂 cePb(Mg₁/₃Nb2/₃)O3 特有的微小偏振迟滞来进一步证明其能力，该迟滞在较小的模拟中被有限尺寸效应所掩盖；预测非晶 ceLi₀.₉NbO₀.₉Cl4.₁ 中的室温场驱动离子电导率为 6.8 ± 0.7~mS/cm；并利用平板校正静电对跨硅/金刚石界面的界面热传输进行建模。通过结合远程物理、电响应推理和分布式计算，该框架将预测原子建模扩展到与设备相关的长度尺度。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题。从摘要能确认的线索包括：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示, 第一性原理标注与结构优化，以及铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注铁电/多铁、极化翻转和电场驱动过程, 声子、有限温度和输运性质, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的HfO₂ 铁电、二维滑移铁电、极化翻转、畴壁和疲劳/缺陷问题嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在HfO₂、Hf₀.₅Zr₀.₅O₂、二维范德华铁电、钙钛矿氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“把电场、极化、应变、氧空位和局域结构序参一起纳入轨迹数据；比较均匀翻转、局域成核和畴壁传播，并用 DFT/有效 Hamiltonian 对关键路径复核”补充训练/验证集，再比较《可扩展的远程机器学习原子间势与原子材料建模的电响应》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Learning the self-energy through equivariant neural networks
core_items.title_zh: 通过等变神经网络学习自能量
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.23717v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: The electronic self-energy determines the single-particle Green's function and, through it, quasiparticle energies and spectral functions, but computing it from first principles is expensive and it is a difficult machine-learning target: complex-valued, matrix-valued in a local-orbital basis, and dependent on a continuous frequency. We predict the dynamical correlation part of the imaginary-frequency G₀W₀ self-energy matrix of molecules from atomic species and coordinates with an E(3)-equivariant message-passing network, the rotational covariance of the orbital-space matrix being imposed by the architecture itself and the static exchange part taken from the density-functional reference. Frequency enters either as an explicit network input or through frequency-specific output heads, and the predicted matrices are continued to the real axis in a representation in which causality and a non-negative spectral density hold by construction. The frequency-conditioned model reproduces matrix elements to below 1 meV on the imaginary axis for the systems studied here, and that accuracy survives the continuation: for water clusters, including a tetramer absent from the training set, and for chemically diverse molecules from QM9, the reconstructed spectral functions follow the G₀W₀ reference peak by peak and the frontier quasiparticle levels are recovered to a few tens of meV. Learning the self-energy on the imaginary axis is therefore a practical route to real-frequency spectra: once the model is trained, and given the density-functional reference it is built on, a new geometry costs no explicit G₀W₀ calculation.
core_items.abstract_zh: 电子自能决定了单粒子格林函数，并通过它决定了准粒子能量和谱函数，但从第一原理计算它的成本很高，而且它是一个困难的机器学习目标：复值、局部轨道基础上的矩阵值，并且依赖于连续频率。我们预测了来自原子种类的分子的虚频 G₀W₀ 自能矩阵的动态相关部分，并与 E(3) 等变消息传递网络进行协调，轨道空间矩阵的旋转协方差由结构本身施加，静态交换部分取自密度泛函参考。频率作为显式网络输入或通过特定于频率的输出头进入，并且预测矩阵以因果关系和非负谱密度通过构造保持的表示延续至实轴。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：等变神经网络与对称性保持表示。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：AI for science 与材料/物理问题的结构化分析。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《通过等变神经网络学习自能量》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Training Dataset Matters for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Water Simulation as an Example
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Training Dataset Matters for Machine Learning Interatomic Potentials: Water Simulation as an Example
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2512.23939v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Accurate predictions of machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) rely on training datasets covering relevant thermodynamic conditions and phases. Using water as an example, we show that insufficiently sampled datasets of MLIPs lead to wrong predictions of densities, melting temperatures, and nuclear quantum effects. In contrast, MLIPs trained on comprehensive datasets with the same electronic structure method yield consistent property predictions agnostic of MLIP architecture, with densities in quantitative agreement with reference calculations.

core_items.title_en: Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs
core_items.title_zh: 文献研究：Multitask learning with semiempirical orbital charges enables sample-efficient MLIPs
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2605.24073v2 Announce Type: replace Abstract: Machine learning interatomic potentials (MLIPs) require generating computationally expensive, large-scale training datasets to accurately simulate materials and molecules. Incorporating electronic structure information using multitask learning improves sample efficiency, however, training on full Hamiltonian matrices, which scale quadratically with the number of atoms, is intractable for large datasets. In this work, we show that multitask learning utilizing orbitally resolved semiempirical charges significantly improves sample efficiency and accuracy in MLIPs. To efficiently predict orbital charges, we implement a specialized equivariant model, reducing charge prediction error compared to an invariant baseline. By augmenting training with computationally inexpensive GFN1-xTB orbital charges, which scale linearly with the number of atoms, our model achieves a 58% reduction in energy mean absolute error relative to energy-only baselines, and requires five times less data to match their performance. Against the stronger baseline of joint energy-and-force training, orbital charges still reduce the energy error by 12%. Furthermore, our approach matches or outperforms models trained on expensive density functional theory (DFT) atomic charges, capturing orbitally resolved electronic complexity and forcing the network to learn a physically accurate latent space that spontaneously clusters metals by shared chemical properties. Because orbital charges are only required during training, this approach preserves inference efficiency, providing a scalable recipe for developing accurate, data-efficient foundation models for complex chemical systems.

core_items.title_en: Engineering nonrelativistic spin splitting in semiconductors by altermagnetic proximity
core_items.title_zh: 通过交变磁邻近工程设计半导体中的非相对论自旋分裂
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.23773v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets combine vanishing net magnetization with momentum-dependent, nonrelativistic spin splitting, offering functionalities attractive for spintronics and quantum devices. Their practical use, however, is constrained by the limited availability of materials that simultaneously possess the required altermagnetic symmetry, semiconducting electronic structure, and weak spin-orbit coupling. Here we show that these requirements can instead be separated between constituent materials through proximity engineering. We develop an analytical theory for a conventional semiconductor coupled to a gapped d-wave altermagnet and demonstrate that virtual tunneling transfers the altermagnetic spin splitting to the semiconductor. Crucially, the induced nonrelativistic and relativistic spin splittings exhibit qualitatively different dependences on band alignment. Virtual processes involving the valence and conduction bands of the altermagnet can reinforce the altermagnetic splitting while contributing with opposite signs to the interfacial Rashba coupling. Consequently, electrostatic tuning can access a regime in which the Rashba splitting vanishes while a sizable d-wave spin splitting persists. Exact diagonalization of the full heterostructure model confirms the analytical theory and establishes the robustness of this mechanism beyond the perturbative regime. Our results identify altermagnetic proximity as a route for engineering nonrelativistic spin-split electronic states in established semiconductor platforms, providing a general strategy for disentangling magnetic and relativistic spin interactions in quantum heterostructures.
core_items.abstract_zh: 交变磁体将消失的净磁化强度与动量相关的非相对论性自旋分裂相结合，为自旋电子学和量子器件提供了有吸引力的功能。然而，它们的实际应用受到同时具有所需的交磁对称性、半导体电子结构和弱自旋轨道耦合的材料的有限可用性的限制。在这里，我们表明，这些要求可以通过邻近工程在组成材料之间分开。我们开发了一种用于与带隙 d 波交变磁体耦合的传统半导体的分析理论，并证明虚拟隧道效应将交变磁体自旋分裂转移到半导体。至关重要的是，引起的非相对论性和相对论性自旋分裂表现出对能带排列的不同性质的依赖性。

core_items.method_point: 方法上，这篇工作可归入磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构。从摘要能确认的线索包括：论文题目和摘要中可确认的方法，以及磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系对应的结构或物理量。若迁移到团队流程，应采用“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”的分层验证，而不是只比较单点能量或单一回归误差。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 它与五位研究人员已有工作的直接连接是：磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构已经出现在团队的方向画像中，可对应到CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物。与传统只做 0 K formation energy/静态势垒的工作相比，这里更应关注磁性、自旋以及自旋—晶格耦合, 晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系, 非共线磁性、DMI/Kitaev 相互作用和交替磁性在温度、缺陷、应变或外场下的变化；摘要没有给出的模型细节不作延伸判断。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对当前研究最具体的启示不是泛泛地“使用 ML”，而是把该文的磁性机器学习势、自旋 Hamiltonian、自旋—晶格动力学和非共线磁结构嵌入现有材料模拟链：先在CrI₃/CrSBr 等范德华磁体、反铁磁/交替磁材料、磁性氧化物中选择一个已有 DFT 数据基础的体系，按“训练集同时覆盖原子位移和自旋构型，显式标注交换、各向异性、DMI 或自旋力；用自旋 MD/MC 与 DFT 自旋能差验证温度、应变和缺陷下的磁序稳定性”补充训练/验证集，再比较《通过交变磁邻近工程设计半导体中的非相对论自旋分裂》对应模型对相稳定、极化/磁序、缺陷或动力学指标的改进。若结果只在训练分布内有效，应通过跨温度、跨应变、跨缺陷浓度和跨超胞测试检查可迁移性。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。

core_items.title_en: Termination-dependent surface Fermiology in the intercalated altermagnet CoNb₄Se₈
core_items.title_zh: 插层交流磁体 CoNb₄Se₈ 中终止相关的表面费米学
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.23375v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Altermagnets have recently gained attention for hosting symmetry-enforced spin-split bands despite zero net magnetization. Angle-resolved photoelectron spectroscopy (ARPES) offers direct access to their electronic structure. However, the intrinsic surface sensitivity of this technique complicates the identification of the observed features: Surface states can be misinterpreted as the spin-split counterpart of bulk bands. This issue becomes particularly relevant for layered intercalated systems, where micrometer-sized domains with distinct terminations often coexist on a cleaved surface. We discuss this scenario for CoNb₄Se₈, one of the first established layered altermagnets. Supported by density functional theory calculations, we employ micro-ARPES to probe individual domains and reveal two contrasting surface terminations. We identify Co- and Se-terminated domains with characteristic surface states arising from bulk-surface connectivity of the material. Our work shows that termination-dependent surface contributions are essential for the reliable spectroscopic identification of altermagnetism and for assessing its presence across the family of layered materials.
core_items.abstract_zh: 尽管净磁化强度为零，但交变磁体最近仍因其具有对称性强制自旋分裂能带而受到关注。角分辨光电子能谱（ARPES）可以直接了解它们的电子结构。然而，该技术固有的表面敏感性使观察到的特征的识别变得复杂：表面态可能被误解为体带的自旋分裂对应物。这个问题对于层状插层系统尤其重要，其中具有不同终端的微米大小的域通常共存于劈裂表面上。我们讨论 CoNb₄Se₈ 的这种情况，CoNb₄Se₈ 是最早建立的层状交流磁体之一。

core_items.title_en: Linear response for machine-learned interatomic potentials: phonons at arbitrary wave vectors from the primitive cell
core_items.title_zh: 机器学习原子间势的线性响应：来自原始细胞的任意波矢量的声子
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.23545v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phonon calculations with machine-learned interatomic potentials are almost exclusively performed with finite displacements in supercells, an approach that is exact only at wave vectors commensurate with the supercell and whose error depends on the range of the force constants. In message-passing networks this range grows with the number of layers, and reaches 140 angstrom for the deepest universal models. Here we show that the dynamical matrix of a message-passing potential can be obtained exactly in the primitive cell, at any wave vector, as the linear response of the forces to a displacement modulated by a Bloch phase, in the spirit of density-functional perturbation theory. The phase enters only where the features of neighboring atoms are gathered, and the trained model is used without modification. One further derivative yields group velocities and mode Grüneisen parameters analytically. We apply the method to NequIP and Prophet, and reproduce the Hessians of supercells to machine precision. Using these results as a reference, we find that the supercells commonly employed in high-throughput calculations lead to errors of several tenths of a THz in the phonon frequencies, and that these errors decrease slowly with the size of the supercell, in particular for deep models. For a low-symmetry silicate, the supercell predicts a dynamical instability that the model does not have. Quantities that depend on derivatives of the dispersion, such as the group velocities and the Grüneisen parameter at low temperature, are considerably more affected than the frequencies themselves. When both approaches are used to obtain the same force constants, their computational cost is comparable for crystals with symmetry.
core_items.abstract_zh: 使用机器学习的原子间势的声子计算几乎完全是在超级单元中的有限位移下进行的，这种方法仅在与超级单元相称的波矢量上才准确，其误差取决于力常数的范围。在消息传递网络中，这个范围随着层数的增加而增长，对于最深的通用模型来说达到 140 埃。在这里，我们证明，本着密度泛函微扰理论的精神，可以在任何波矢量下在原胞中精确地获得消息传递势的动态矩阵，作为力对布洛赫相位调制的位移的线性响应。仅当相邻原子的特征聚集时才进入该阶段，并且训练后的模型无需修改即可使用。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 使用机器学习的原子间势的声子计算几乎完全是在超级单元中的有限位移下进行的，这种方法仅在与超级单元相称的波矢量上才准确，其误差取决于力常数的范围。在消息传递网络中，这个范围随着层数的增加而增长，对于最深的通用模型来说达到 140 埃。在这里，我们证明，本着密度泛函微扰理论的精神，可以在任何波矢量下在原胞中精确地获得消息传递势的动态矩阵，作为力对布洛赫相位调制的位移的线性响应。仅当相邻原子的特征聚集时才进入该阶段，并且训练后的模型无需修改即可使用。另一种导数可通过分析得出群速度和模式 Grüneisen 参数。我们将该方法应用于 NequIP 和 Prophet，并重现了超级单元的 Hessian 矩阵以达到机器精度。以这些结果为参考，我们发现高通量计算中常用的超级单元会导致声子频率达到十分之几太赫兹的误差，并且这些误差随着超级单元的尺寸缓慢减小，特别是对于深度模型。对于低对称性硅酸盐，超晶胞预测了模型所不具备的动力学不稳定性。取决于色散导数的量（例如低温下的群速度和 Grüneisen 参数）比频率本身受到的影响要大得多。当使用两种方法获得相同的力常数时，对于对称晶体，它们的计算成本是相当的。

core_items.title_en: From Surface Reactions to Inhibitor Coverage: A Machine-Learning-Assisted Computational Study of Area-Selective Atomic Layer Deposition
core_items.title_zh: 从表面反应到抑制剂覆盖：区域选择性原子层沉积的机器学习辅助计算研究
core_items.abstract: arXiv:2610.22911v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Area-selective atomic layer deposition (AS-ALD) enables selective material growth for the fabrication of nanoscale semiconductor devices. Predicting inhibitor coverage is essential for understanding and optimizing surface blocking in AS-ALD. Here, we present a computational workflow combining a pretrained universal machine-learning interatomic potential with off-lattice grand canonical Monte Carlo simulations and apply it to inhibitor adsorption and precursor blocking on amorphous SiO2. Realistic surface models reveal substantial site-dependent variations in reaction energies and activation barriers, with silanol groups serving as the primary adsorption sites for aminosilane and related inhibitors and metal precursors. Coverage simulations show that inhibitors producing identical adsorbed fragments can yield different coverages because the intact molecules impose distinct steric constraints, leading to different accessible site densities and blocking capabilities. Beyond coverage, we highlight the importance of the reactivity of adsorbed inhibitor fragments toward precursors in determining inhibitor stability and blocking performance. Together, these findings demonstrate the need to consider both steric effects and chemical reactivity on realistic amorphous surfaces. Our calculations connect local reaction chemistry with inhibitor coverage and provide a computational basis for understanding inhibition mechanisms and selecting suitable inhibitor-precursor combinations for AS-ALD.
core_items.abstract_zh: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。
core_items.abstract_zh_full: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。覆盖模拟表明，产生相同吸附片段的抑制剂可以产生不同的覆盖范围，因为完整的分子施加不同的空间限制，导致不同的可接近位点密度和阻断能力。除了覆盖范围之外，我们还强调了吸附的抑制剂片段对前体的反应性在确定抑制剂稳定性和阻断性能方面的重要性。总之，这些发现表明需要考虑现实非晶表面上的空间效应和化学反应性。我们的计算将局部反应化学与抑制剂覆盖率联系起来，并为理解抑制机制和为 AS-ALD 选择合适的抑制剂-前体组合提供计算基础。
core_items.summary: 区域选择性原子层沉积 (AS-ALD) 能够实现选择性材料生长，用于制造纳米级半导体器件。预测抑制剂覆盖率对于理解和优化 AS-ALD 中的表面封闭至关重要。在这里，我们提出了一种计算工作流程，将预训练的通用机器学习原子间势与晶格外正则蒙特卡罗模拟相结合，并将其应用于非晶 SiO2 上的抑制剂吸附和前体阻断。真实的表面模型揭示了反应能量和活化势垒的显着位点依赖性变化，其中硅烷醇基团充当氨基硅烷和相关抑制剂和金属前体的主要吸附位点。
core_items.method_point: 方法上，摘要目前只能确认：蒙特卡洛统计采样。需要回到原文核对数据来源、标签定义、模型架构、物理约束和验证集，不能把题名直接等同于可迁移算法。若要接入团队的 ML 势或 Hamiltonian 流程，应先确认它是否同时学习能量、力、应力、自旋、极化或电子结构，以及是否报告跨材料/跨温度外推。还需核对原文的训练数据规模、损失函数、边界条件和误差分解，才能判断其是否适合团队的材料模拟任务。
core_items.related_work: 与团队方向的可能连接在于：晶体结构、功能材料和结构—性质关系。团队已有机器学习势、第一性原理、有效 Hamiltonian、缺陷计算、电子—声子耦合和有限温度动力学基础，但该文是否提供可复用数据或物理量仍需查证。若研究对象属于机器人、量子信息或电网等非材料场景，关联主要是物理约束学习、少样本建模或不确定性评估，而不是直接迁移材料机制。这种联系应通过同一材料体系上的独立基准和跨分布测试确认，不能仅凭方法名称或期刊来源下结论。
core_items.implication: 对《从表面反应到抑制剂覆盖：区域选择性原子层沉积的机器学习辅助计算研究》的启示是先做可证伪的对接：从一个已有材料体系和小规模 DFT 基准开始，明确输入、目标、基线和外推测试，再决定是否接入铁电/磁性、缺陷或载流子动力学工作。具体可先把该文的表示或损失函数在 HfO₂、二维滑移铁电、CrI₃/CrSBr、SiC/GaN 缺陷或卤化物钙钛矿上做小规模复现；若没有直接交叉，应保留为方法参考而非强行迁移。第一步可以选取团队已有的 HfO₂、二维磁体、半导体缺陷或钙钛矿数据做小样本试验，再决定是否扩大到生产级计算。
